items.en: Sakura mochi — pink mochi around chunky red bean, wrapped in a salt-pickled cherry leaf; the salt of the leaf against the sweet bean is the whole point. Eating the leaf is optional and both are normal
items.section: 季節の和菓子 Seasonal wagashi
items.note: 店の説明は「ピンク色の餅」＝道明寺系（米）と読めるが、関東の長命寺式桜餅は小麦粉の皮を使う。必ず確認のこと。Kanto-style sakuramochi is often a WHEAT-FLOUR crepe; this one is described as mochi (rice), but confirm.

items.en: Isobe mochi — a springy grilled rice cake dipped in sweet-salty soy and wrapped in a broad sheet of nori. The shop calls the bounce of the mochi its proudest point
items.section: 季節の和菓子 Seasonal wagashi
items.note: 甘辛の醤油＝小麦。The soy dip contains wheat.

items.en: Boxed zenzai with mochi — sweet Tokachi bean soup with a rice cake in it, sold as a take-home gift box. The shop's most-given omiyage
items.note: 十勝産の豆と餅。原材料に小麦は入らないが店の表示なし。要確認。

items.en: Ogura mizu-yokan — Kikuya's own recipe for the summer jelly-set red bean bar; smooth, cold, barely sweet. Priced per bar
items.note: あずき・砂糖・寒天。小麦不使用と思われるが店のアレルゲン表示なし。Azuki, sugar and agar; no published allergen statement.

tokyo_anago_ryo_ri_to_jizake_a.price_note: Prices approximate — may change. From the shop's own official Gnavi pages (税込; address confirmed as 台東区西浅草2-26-1 坂田ビル1F), checked 2026-08-20. Lunch 12:00–14:30, dinner 17:30–23:00, closed Mondays.

items.en: Raw conger sashimi — the reason to come. Anago is almost never served raw because its blood is toxic until properly bled and trimmed; here it arrives with a crisp, snapping texture and a clean sweet fat, nothing like the simmered version
items.note: 魚自体は小麦不使用。つけ醤油＝小麦。GF タマリを持参するか、塩で食べられるか確認を。The fish is fine; the dipping soy is wheat.

items.en: Plain-grilled conger — no sauce, just salt and the grill; the fillet puffs and the fat renders out. Eaten with wasabi and a squeeze of citrus
items.note: タレを使わない白焼きはこの店で最も小麦を避けやすい一品。ただし下ごしらえの酒・醤油の有無を要確認。The sauce-free grill is the best GF candidate on this menu — confirm no soy in the prep.

items.en: Conger tempura — a long fillet in light batter, fried until the tail shatters
items.note: 天ぷら衣＝小麦粉、共用フライヤー。Wheat batter, shared fryer.

items.en: Breadcrumbed fried conger — panko crust, thicker and crunchier than the tempura
items.note: パン粉＝小麦。Panko is wheat.

items.en: Blanched conger — dipped in boiling water then iced so the skin softens while the flesh stays firm; served cold with ponzu or plum
items.note: ポン酢・煎り酒に醤油＝小麦の可能性。Ponzu almost always contains wheat soy sauce.

items.en: 'Snow-view' natto — fermented soybeans under a drift of grated daikon; a cold, sharp counterweight to all the eel fat
items.note: 納豆添付のたれ＝醤油（小麦）。卵黄が乗る場合あり要確認。Natto sauce sachets are wheat soy; ask whether an egg yolk is added.

items.en: Conger yukhoe — chopped raw eel dressed Korean-style, sesame oil and usually an egg yolk on top
items.note: ユッケだれ＝醤油・コチュジャン（いずれも小麦）。卵黄使用。

items.en: Vinegared conger — cold, in a light sweet-vinegar dressing with cucumber
items.note: 三杯酢に醤油を使う場合あり。要確認。

items.en: Grilled conger liver — a couple of skewers of the innards, bitter and rich; the classic thing to drink sake with
items.note: タレ焼き＝醤油・味醂＝小麦。

items.en: Seared conger — flame-kissed on the surface, still raw at the centre
items.note: 塩で出すかタレを塗るかで変わる。要確認。Depends whether it is finished with salt or with tare.

items.en: Yanagawa-nabe — conger and slivered burdock simmered in sweet soy broth and set with beaten egg, served bubbling in its own little pan
items.note: 割下＝醤油・味醂＝小麦。卵使用。

items.en: Simmered conger — poached slowly in sweet soy until it gives way under the chopsticks; the Edo preparation
items.note: 煮汁＝醤油＝小麦。

items.en: Seared Bungo beef — Oita's wagyu, flash-seared and sliced. The owner is an Oita man, which is why the beef, the kabosu and the chicken dishes are all from there
items.note: つけダレに醤油の可能性。要確認。

items.en: Bungo beef nigiri — one piece of seared wagyu over sushi rice
items.note: 握りに塗るタレ・煮切り醤油＝小麦。

items.en: Stewed Bungo beef — long-braised in a sweet-savoury broth
items.note: 煮込みの調味＝醤油・味噌＝小麦の可能性大。

items.en: Conger rice bowl — simmered anago fanned over rice with its own reduced sauce. The house lunch
items.note: タレ＝醤油＝小麦。

items.en: Conger in a lacquer box — the larger, more generous version of the don: more fillets, better presentation
items.note: タレ＝醤油＝小麦。

items.en: Conger chazuke — eel over rice with hot broth poured on at the table; the way to finish a drinking session
items.note: 出汁・煮穴子とも醤油使用。

items.en: Plum chazuke — salted plum over rice, hot broth poured on; sour and cleansing
items.note: 出汁に白だし・醤油を使う場合＝小麦。鰹だしのためビーガン不可の可能性大。Broth is usually katsuo dashi (not vegan) and often carries wheat soy.

items.en: Spicy cod-roe chazuke — marinated mentaiko over rice, broth poured on
items.note: 明太子の漬け込み液に醤油・酒＝小麦の可能性大。

items.en: Raw conger nigiri — one piece; the rare raw preparation, over rice
items.note: 煮切り醤油を刷く場合＝小麦。塩で握ってもらえるか要確認。

items.en: Simmered conger nigiri — one piece, brushed with the sweet reduction (tsume)
items.note: ツメ＝醤油ベース＝小麦。

items.en: Conger & cucumber roll — thin nori roll of simmered eel and cucumber
items.note: 煮穴子＝醤油。

items.en: Pickle plate — the house pickles, to keep drinking with
items.note: 漬物の一部は醤油漬け＝小麦。かつお節をまぶす場合ビーガン不可。

items.en: Chicken tempura — Oita's own dish: chicken in a soft, eggy tempura batter, dipped in ponzu rather than tentsuyu
items.note: 天ぷら衣＝小麦。

items.en: Seared free-range chicken tataki — charred outside, raw at the centre, sliced thin with ponzu and ginger
items.note: ポン酢に醤油＝小麦。

items.en: Chicken nanban — the Miyazaki dish: battered fried chicken dunked in sweet vinegar and blanketed with egg tartare
items.note: 小麦粉＋卵の衣、南蛮酢に醤油、タルタルに卵。

items.en: Potato salad — the izakaya staple, mashed with cucumber and onion
items.note: マヨネーズ＝卵。和風の隠し味に醤油を使う店もあるため要確認。

items.en: Green salad — leaves with the house dressing
items.note: 和風ドレッシングは醤油・かつお節を使う可能性。要確認。

items.en: Draught beer
items.note: ビールは麦芽＝グルテン。Beer is never gluten-free.

items.en: Bottled beer, medium bottle
items.note: 麦芽＝グルテン。

items.en: Fresh lemon sour — shochu, soda and a lemon squeezed at the counter
items.note: ベースが芋焼酎なら小麦不使用だが、この店は麦焼酎も5種置いている。どの焼酎を使うか必ず確認を。Ask WHICH shochu — the barley (麦) ones are not GF.

items.en: Fresh kabosu sour — the same drink with Oita's green citrus instead of lemon
items.note: ベース焼酎の種類を要確認（麦焼酎なら不可）。

items.en: Oolong-hai — shochu long with oolong tea
items.note: ベース焼酎の種類を要確認。烏龍茶自体は茶葉のみ。

items.en: Green-tea highball — shochu with cold green tea
items.note: ベース焼酎の種類を要確認。

items.ja: 芋焼酎（七窪・万膳・万膳庵・龍宮・和助・狼ほか13種）
items.en: Sweet-potato shochu by the glass — thirteen labels, nearly all one price; bottle-keep ¥4,290. This is the half of the list to look at if you are avoiding gluten
items.section: ≪地酒・焼酎・泡盛≫ Shochu & sake
items.note: 芋焼酎は芋と米麹が原料で通常グルテンフリー。同店の麦焼酎（八重桜・情け嶋・泥亀・牟禮鶴・泰明）は大麦のため不可。Sweet-potato shochu is distilled from potato and rice koji; the shop's 麦焼酎 shelf is barley and is NOT gluten-free.

items.ja: 日本酒（鍋島・今西・美丈夫・不動・花の香・高千代・天青・屋守・雅山流ほか）
items.en: Sake by the glass — a tight, personally chosen ten-label list: 鍋島 (Saga), 今西 (Nara), 美丈夫 (Kochi), 不動 (Chiba), 花の香 (Kumamoto), 高千代 (Niigata), 天青 (Kanagawa), 屋守 (Tokyo), 雅山流 (Yamagata)
items.section: ≪地酒・焼酎・泡盛≫ Shochu & sake
items.note: 日本酒は米・米麹が原料で通常グルテンフリー。醸造アルコール添加の銘柄もあるため厳密には要確認。

items.en: Soft drinks — cola or oolong tea
items.note: 烏龍茶は茶葉のみで小麦不使用（麦茶とは別物）。Oolong is tea leaf only, unlike 麦茶 barley tea.

tokyo_boju.price_note: Prices approximate — may change. Read off photographs of the shop's own boards: the handwritten 一品料理 whiteboard and the laminated タイムサービス lunch card, both photographed 2026-08 (the same board also appears unchanged in 2026-04), and the お飲み物 card photographed 2026-01. The ¥500 chirashi and the ¥3,500→¥1,500 極上ちらし are corroborated by dated 2026 reviews. Address confirmed 台東区浅草1-8-5. A few prices on the drinks card were not legible enough to transcribe and are omitted rather than guessed.

items.en: Standard chirashi — a bowl of vinegared sushi rice scattered with the day's offcuts of fish. Five hundred yen, tax included, in central Asakusa, weekends too; this is the cheapest proper sushi lunch you will find near Kaminarimon and the reason the shop has a queue
items.section: タイムサービス ランチメニュー（15時まで）Lunch, until 15:00
items.note: 酢飯（米酢・砂糖・塩）は小麦不使用だが、つけ醤油・煮切りが小麦。GFタマリ持参の相談を。Sushi rice itself is wheat-free; the soy is not.

items.en: Deluxe chirashi — the shop's number-one seller: uni, ikura, prawn, scallop, conger and tuna heaped over the rice. Normally ¥3,500, cut to ¥1,500 before 15:00, which is the whole trick of the place
items.section: タイムサービス ランチメニュー（15時まで）Lunch, until 15:00
items.note: 煮穴子が乗る場合＝醤油（小麦）。ネタと醤油の両方を要確認。Simmered conger, if present, is cooked in wheat soy.

items.en: Raw whale sashimi — dark red, closer to beef than to fish, eaten with grated ginger. Rare on a modern menu and one of the reasons regulars come
items.section: 一品料理 全て500円 — Small plates, all ¥500
items.note: 魚肉自体は小麦不使用。つけ醤油＝小麦。

items.en: Shiokara — squid fermented in its own salted innards; intensely savoury, meant to be chased with sake
items.section: 一品料理 全て500円 — Small plates, all ¥500
items.note: 市販・自家製とも醤油や味醂を加える場合が多い。要確認。Many shiokara recipes add soy or mirin.

items.en: Sesame tofu — not tofu at all but ground sesame set with kudzu starch; dense, faintly sweet, cool
items.section: 一品料理 全て500円 — Small plates, all ¥500
items.note: ごま豆腐自体はごまと葛粉で小麦不使用・植物性。掛けだれ（だし醤油・わさび醤油）に小麦と鰹だしが入るため要確認。The block itself is sesame and kudzu; the sauce poured over it is the problem.

items.en: Wild mozuku seaweed — fine, slippery strands in a sweet-sour dressing; taken as a palate-cleanser
items.section: 一品料理 全て500円 — Small plates, all ¥500
items.note: もずく酢の三杯酢に醤油＝小麦、だしに鰹＝ビーガン不可の可能性大。

items.en: Blackthroat seaperch, dried and grilled — the most prized dried fish in Japan, oily enough that the skin crisps and the flesh stays wet
items.section: 一品料理 全て500円 — Small plates, all ¥500
items.note: 干物は塩干しなら小麦不使用だが、醤油干し・味醂干しの製品もある。要確認。

items.en: Scallop isobe-yaki — scallop grilled with soy and wrapped in nori
items.section: 一品料理 全て500円 — Small plates, all ¥500
items.note: 磯辺焼きは醤油ダレ＝小麦。

items.en: Pickle assortment — a plate of the house pickles
items.section: 一品料理 全て500円 — Small plates, all ¥500
items.note: 醤油漬け・粕漬けは小麦。鰹節をまぶす場合ビーガン不可。

items.en: Grilled dried sardine — salted, dried, then grilled over the counter
items.section: 一品料理 全て500円 — Small plates, all ¥500
items.note: 塩干しなら小麦不使用。醤油干しの可能性を要確認。

items.ja: ハタハタ 干物焼き
items.en: Grilled dried sandfish — the Sea-of-Japan winter fish, small-boned and soft enough to eat whole
items.section: 一品料理 全て500円 — Small plates, all ¥500
items.note: 塩干しなら小麦不使用。要確認。

items.en: Icefish — translucent little whitebait, served raw and slippery; a spring item
items.section: 一品料理 全て500円 — Small plates, all ¥500
items.note: 生食のつけ醤油＝小麦。

items.en: Fresh yuba sashimi — the skin lifted off simmering soy milk, eaten cold like sashimi. Creamy, barely sweet
items.section: 一品料理 全て500円 — Small plates, all ¥500
items.note: ゆば自体は大豆のみで植物性・小麦不使用。わさび醤油／だし醤油をかけると小麦＋鰹だし。醤油抜きを頼めるか確認を。The yuba is soy milk only; the sauce is the issue for both diets.

items.en: Three-way 'chopstick rest' plate — three small palate-resetting sides, whatever the counter has that day
items.section: 一品料理 全て500円 — Small plates, all ¥500
items.note: 内容が日替わりのため個別に要確認。Contents change daily — ask what is on it.

items.en: Bigfin squid okizuke — squid steeped alive in soy at sea, so the marinade goes right through it. Very dark, very savoury
items.section: 一品料理 全て500円 — Small plates, all ¥500
items.note: 沖漬けの漬け汁＝醤油・味醂＝小麦。The whole preparation is a soy marinade.

items.en: Eighty-year nukazuke — vegetables pickled in a rice-bran bed that has been fed continuously for eighty years. Sour, funky, alive
items.section: 一品料理 全て500円 — Small plates, all ¥500
items.note: ぬか床は米ぬか・塩が基本で小麦不使用だが、長年の床にビール・麦・粕を足す家も多い。この床の内容を要確認。A nuka bed is rice bran and salt, but beer or barley is a common addition to old beds — ask.

items.en: Grilled roe-full shishamo — smelt grilled whole, the belly packed with eggs
items.section: 一品料理 全て500円 — Small plates, all ¥500
items.note: 塩焼きなら小麦不使用。すだち・大根おろしに醤油をかけると小麦。

items.en: Raw bamboo shoot sashimi — freshly dug shoot, sliced thin; sweet, faintly bitter, crunchy. A short spring window
items.section: 一品料理 全て500円 — Small plates, all ¥500
items.note: たけのこ自体は植物性・小麦不使用。わさび醤油／木の芽味噌に小麦（醤油・麦味噌）の可能性。

items.en: Raw firefly squid — thumb-sized whole squid eaten raw, a few weeks in spring only; sweet and briny
items.section: 一品料理 全て500円 — Small plates, all ¥500
items.note: 定番の酢味噌に麦味噌を使う場合＝小麦。醤油も同様。

items.en: Boiled firefly squid — the cooked version, firmer, usually with vinegar-miso
items.section: 一品料理 全て500円 — Small plates, all ¥500
items.note: 酢味噌の味噌が麦味噌なら小麦。要確認。

items.en: Iced coffee — unexpectedly on a sushi counter's board, and the same ¥500 as everything else
items.section: 一品料理 全て500円 — Small plates, all ¥500
items.note: コーヒー豆のみなら小麦不使用。ブラックなら植物性。ミルク・ガムシロップの有無を確認。

items.ja: グラスワイン（ランチタイムのみ・1杯限定）
items.en: Glass of wine at lunch — one glass per person, lunchtime only, ¥300. The board makes a point of it
items.section: ランチタイム限定 Lunch only
items.note: ワインはぶどうが原料で通常小麦不使用だが、清澄剤に卵白・ゼラチンを使う銘柄はビーガン不可。Wine is grape-based; fining agents can be animal-derived.

items.ja: 生ビール（アサヒスーパードライ / アサヒ プレミアム熟撰）
items.en: Draught beer — Asahi Super Dry, and Asahi Premium Jukusen for the better pour. Three sizes, up to a 特大ジョッキ that arrives the size of a vase
items.price: ¥600（小グラス）/ ¥800（中ジョッキ）/ ¥1,500（特大ジョッキ）
items.note: ビールは麦芽＝グルテン。Beer is never gluten-free.

items.ja: 瓶ビール 各種（中瓶）
items.en: Bottled beer, medium bottle
items.note: 麦芽＝グルテン。

items.en: Sake — a rotating selection, priced from ¥1,000 the ichigo (180ml)
items.note: 日本酒は米・米麹で通常グルテンフリー。銘柄ごとに要確認。

items.ja: ソフトドリンク 各種
items.en: Soft drinks — the usual range
items.note: 内容不明のため個別に要確認。麦茶が含まれる場合それは小麦（大麦）。If barley tea (麦茶) is among them, that one contains gluten.

tokyo_saamrot.price_note: Prices approximate — may change. From the shop's own メニュー page; the first figure is pre-tax as the shop prints it, the 税込 figure in brackets is what you pay. Checked 2026-08-20. Address 新宿区歌舞伎町1-2-19 三権ビル2F. The shop states the printed list is only part of the menu, and that spice level is made to order — from none at all to violently hot.

items.ja: ベトナム風海老の生春巻（ポッピア・ソッ）
items.en: Vietnamese fresh spring rolls with prawn — rice paper around prawn, herbs and vermicelli, not fried. The shop's number-one item
items.section: 当店の人気メニュー Best 10
items.note: ライスペーパーは米粉で小麦不使用だが、つけだれのホイシン／甜麺醤は小麦を含むことが多い。海老使用。Rice paper is fine; the hoisin-style dip usually is not.

items.ja: 春雨の和え（ヤム・ウンセン）
items.en: Glass-noodle salad — mung-bean noodles tossed hot-and-sour with lime, chilli, minced pork and prawn. Sharp and cold
items.section: 当店の人気メニュー Best 10
items.note: 春雨は緑豆でんぷんで小麦不使用。ナンプラー・シーユー（醤油）に小麦の可能性。要確認。Glass noodles are mung bean; the seasoning may include soy.

items.ja: 空芯菜炒め（パックブン・ファイデーン）
items.en: Water spinach stir-fried at flame height — the wok is set alight for this one; garlic, chilli and fermented soybean, hollow stems still squeaking
items.section: 当店の人気メニュー Best 10
items.note: タオチオ（発酵大豆）やオイスターソースに小麦を含む場合が多い。オイスターソース使用ならビーガン不可。The fermented soybean and oyster sauces both commonly contain wheat; oyster sauce also rules out vegan.

items.ja: 鶏肉のグリーンカレー（ゲーンキョウワーン・ガイ）
items.en: Green curry with chicken — coconut milk, green chilli paste, Thai aubergine and sweet basil. Order it over rice
items.section: 当店の人気メニュー Best 10
items.note: ココナッツミルクとカレーペーストは通常小麦不使用だが、ナンプラー・シーズニングソースに小麦を含む製品あり。エビペースト（カピ）使用のためビーガン不可。Curry paste normally contains shrimp paste, so not vegan; ask about wheat in the fish sauce.

items.ja: 鶏肉のマッサマンカレー（ゲーン・マッサマン・ガイ）
items.en: Massaman curry with chicken — the mild, Persian-influenced one: cinnamon, cardamom, peanuts and potato in coconut milk
items.section: 当店の人気メニュー Best 10
items.note: ピーナッツ使用。ペーストにエビペースト。ナンプラー・タマリンドの小麦は要確認。Contains peanuts and usually shrimp paste.

items.ja: ブラックタイガー酸辛スープ（トムヤム・クン）
items.en: Tom yum with black tiger prawns — lemongrass, galangal, kaffir lime and chilli, hot and sour in equal measure. Two sizes
items.section: 当店の人気メニュー Best 10
items.note: ハーブとナンプラーが中心で小麦の可能性は低いが、ナンプラー・シーズニングソースの原材料を要確認。海老使用。

items.ja: 鶏肉ガパオライス目玉焼きのせ（カーウグラッパオ・ガイ・カイダーウ）
items.romaji: khao rad gaprao gai khai dao
items.en: Holy-basil chicken over rice with a fried egg — minced chicken, garlic, bird's-eye chilli and holy basil, the egg white lace-crisp at the edges. The default Thai lunch
items.section: 当店の人気メニュー Best 10
items.note: ガパオの味付けはシーユーダム（黒醤油）・オイスターソースが基本＝小麦の可能性大。卵使用。Holy-basil stir-fry is built on dark soy and oyster sauce.

items.ja: カオマンガイ 海南鶏飯（カーウマンガイ）
items.en: Hainanese chicken rice — poached chicken over rice cooked in the poaching broth, with a ginger-and-soybean sauce and a bowl of clear soup
items.section: 当店の人気メニュー Best 10
items.note: 鶏と米自体は小麦不使用。タオチオ（発酵大豆ソース）に小麦の可能性大。ソース抜きで食べられるか確認を。The chicken and rice are fine; the fermented-soybean sauce is the risk.

items.ja: バンコク風焼きそば（パッタイ）
items.en: Pad thai — flat rice noodles with tamarind, egg, prawn, bean sprouts, crushed peanut and a lime wedge
items.section: 当店の人気メニュー Best 10
items.note: 麺は米で小麦不使用。タレのシーズニングソース・オイスターソースに小麦の可能性。卵・ピーナッツ・干し海老使用。Rice noodles, but the sauce and the egg are the problems.

items.ja: トムヤム・クン ラーメン（クワィティョウ・トムヤム）
items.en: Tom yum noodle soup — the hot-sour prawn broth poured over rice noodles; a full meal in a bowl
items.section: 当店の人気メニュー Best 10
items.note: クワィティョウは米麺。スープの調味料に小麦の可能性を要確認。日本語で「ラーメン」と書かれているが小麦麺ではない。Despite the word ラーメン on the menu, the noodle is rice.

items.ja: タイ風パパイヤのソムタム（ソムタム・タイ）
items.en: Green papaya salad, Thai style — shredded unripe papaya pounded in the mortar with lime, palm sugar, dried shrimp and peanut
items.section: タイ人に人気メニュー Best 5
items.note: 干し海老・ナンプラー使用でビーガン不可。ナンプラーの小麦は要確認。ピーナッツ使用。

items.ja: 発酵豚肉ピリ辛揚げの野菜包み（ネーム・クルック）
items.en: Crispy rice salad with fermented pork — deep-fried curried rice balls crumbled with sour cured pork, peanuts, ginger and herbs, scooped up in lettuce leaves
items.section: タイ人に人気メニュー Best 5
items.note: 揚げ物のため共用フライヤー、衣・調味に小麦の可能性大。豚肉使用。Deep-fried in a shared fryer.

items.ja: ソフトシェルクラブの激辛炒め（プーニム・パッキーマオ）
items.en: Soft-shell crab, drunkard's stir-fry — the whole crab floured and fried, then wok-tossed with green peppercorn, chilli and holy basil. Genuinely hot
items.section: タイ人に人気メニュー Best 5
items.note: ソフトシェルクラブは小麦粉をまぶして揚げるのが定番。パッキーマオの味付けもシーユー＝小麦。Floured and fried, then finished in a soy-based sauce.

items.ja: シーフード酸辛スープ（ポテーック）
items.en: Po taek — the 'broken fish trap' soup: tom-yum broth loaded with prawn, squid, mussel and white fish. Two sizes
items.section: タイ人に人気メニュー Best 5
items.note: ハーブとナンプラー中心。調味料の小麦を要確認。魚介多用。

items.ja: タイスキ（スキーナーム）
items.en: Thai suki — a hotpot of meat, seafood, tofu and vegetables with the fermented red suki dipping sauce; choose glass noodles or rice noodles
items.section: タイ人に人気メニュー Best 5
items.note: 麺は春雨かライス麺を選べるため小麦不使用。スキーのタレは発酵豆腐・醤油ベースで小麦の可能性大。つみれ・餃子など具に小麦。Noodle choice is wheat-free, but the sauce and several of the pot items are not.

items.ja: Cセット 鶏肉のバジル炒めセット
items.en: Lunch set C — holy-basil chicken with salad, soup, dessert and a drink. Add a half bowl of pho, tom-yum noodles or pad thai for ¥250 (¥275 incl.)
items.section: ランチのおすすめ Best 5（全17セット）
items.note: ガパオはシーユー・オイスターソース＝小麦の可能性大。セットのデザート内容も要確認。

items.ja: Lセット トムヤムクン セット（ハーフガパオ・ライス付）
items.en: Lunch set L — tom yum kung with a half portion of holy-basil chicken and rice, plus salad, soup, dessert and a drink
items.section: ランチのおすすめ Best 5（全17セット）
items.note: ガパオ部分＝小麦の可能性大。

items.ja: Dセット シーフードのバジル炒めセット
items.en: Lunch set D — holy-basil seafood stir-fry with salad, soup, dessert and a drink
items.section: ランチのおすすめ Best 5（全17セット）
items.note: 同上、シーユー・オイスターソース＝小麦の可能性大。

items.ja: Iセット サームロットセット
items.en: Lunch set I — the house sampler: fresh spring roll, half a Thai omelette, half a green curry and rice. The best way to try several things at once
items.section: ランチのおすすめ Best 5（全17セット）
items.note: 卵使用（タイ風オムレツ）。生春巻のたれ、カレーの調味料に小麦の可能性。

items.ja: Kセット レディースセット
items.en: Lunch set K — fresh spring roll, Thai glass-noodle salad and a half portion of fried rice
items.section: ランチのおすすめ Best 5（全17セット）
items.note: チャーハンの調味に醤油＝小麦の可能性。ヤムウンセンにナンプラー。

items.ja: カオマンガイセット（レイトランチ）
items.romaji: late lunch — khao man gai set
items.en: Late-lunch Hainanese chicken rice set — can be swapped for the deep-fried version of the chicken. Served 14:30–17:00 (L.O. 16:30), when the room is quiet
items.section: レイトランチのおすすめ Best 5（14:30〜17:00）
items.note: タオチオソースに小麦の可能性。揚げカオマンガイに変更した場合は衣・共用フライヤーで小麦。

items.ja: グリーンカレーセット（鶏肉・ライス付）
items.en: Late-lunch green curry set with chicken and rice, plus salad, soup, dessert and a drink
items.section: レイトランチのおすすめ Best 5（14:30〜17:00）
items.note: カレーペーストにエビペースト＝ビーガン不可。調味料の小麦を要確認。

items.en: Late-lunch pad thai set — the cheapest of the late sets, with salad, soup, dessert and a drink
items.section: レイトランチのおすすめ Best 5（14:30〜17:00）
items.note: 米麺だがタレに小麦の可能性、卵・ピーナッツ使用。

items.en: Thai course, for four or more — glass-noodle salad, mixed vegetable stir-fry, minced-prawn spring rolls, soft-shell crab with egg curry, tom yum kung, jasmine rice, and tapioca in coconut milk. Add all-you-can-drink for ¥2,000 (¥2,200 incl.) a head
items.section: コースメニュー Courses（4名様〜）
items.note: 揚げ春巻き・ソフトシェルクラブとも小麦の衣と共用フライヤー。海老・卵使用。Two fried courses put wheat into this menu.

items.en: Vietnamese course, for four or more — prawn fresh rolls, Vietnamese papaya salad, prawn on sugarcane, seasonal greens, banh xeo, pho, and tapioca in coconut milk
items.section: コースメニュー Courses（4名様〜）
items.note: サトウキビ揚げは揚げ物、バインセオの衣は米粉だが共用フライヤー。フォーは米麺。全体としては小麦混入の可能性が高い。

items.en: Thai suki hotpot course, for four or more — chicken, pork and beef, blue crab, scallop, green mussel, tofu, black tiger prawn and oyster; beef-and-coriander nori rolls, pork-wrapped squid, spring onion in pork, one-bite gyoza, prawn/fish/pork balls, a mound of mushrooms and vegetables, glass noodles and egg, then rice noodles or jasmine rice, and tapioca dessert. The shop says the secret is the dipping sauce
items.section: コースメニュー Courses（4名様〜）
items.note: ひとくち餃子の皮＝小麦。つみれ・練り物にも小麦つなぎの可能性。スキのタレも小麦の可能性大。The gyoza wrappers alone put wheat in this course.

items.en: Two 'girls' night' courses, four or more women, 2½ hours — six dishes plus two desserts: fresh spring roll, glass-noodle salad, seasonal greens, fried chicken gaprao, tom yum kung, pad thai, then grilled banana-and-sticky-rice in coconut and an ice cream (coconut or chocolate). Either with two drinks, or with all-you-can-drink
items.section: コースメニュー Courses（女性4名様〜）
items.note: 鶏唐揚げガパオ＝小麦の衣と共用フライヤー。アイスクリームは乳製品。

items.en: All-you-can-drink, two hours (L.O. at 90 min), only with a course — Asahi Super Dry, house wine, jasmine/oolong/green-tea highballs, lemon, lime, kyoho and grapefruit sours, whisky, highball, Malibu orange and milk, Campari soda and orange, gin tonic, gin rickey; soft drinks are iced jasmine, oolong and green tea and orange, grapefruit, mango and lychee juice. Extensions ¥660 for 30 min, ¥1,100 for 60
items.note: ビール・ウイスキー・ハイボールは麦芽＝グルテンで不可。ジャスミン茶・ウーロン茶・各種ジュースは小麦不使用。マリブミルクは乳製品。The beer, whisky and highball are all barley; the teas and juices are not.

tokyo_mamekobo_suidobashi_self.price_note: Prices approximate — may change. Read off a full-resolution photograph of the shop's own laminated counter price card (photo dated 2025/03); the card's own line is ※飲み物は全て税込価格です. IMPORTANT: a sign photographed in 2026/01 reads 「ドリンクＳサイズは販売終了いたしました」 — the S size has since been discontinued, so the smallest size now sold is M. Prices approximate — may change. A ¥550 otoshi (table charge) applies.

items.en: Chilled soba on a slatted box with dipping tsuyu — the shop's calling card. Choose 更科 (sarashina, pale inner flour) or 十割 (juwari, 100% buckwheat)
items.section: おそば クラシック Classic soba
items.note: 店の公式アレルゲン表で小麦・大麦とも「該当なし」、つゆは特製グルテンフリー辛汁。Shop's own allergen chart marks both 小麦 (wheat) and 大麦 (barley) 該当なし, and unusually for Japan the dipping tsuyu is a purpose-made gluten-free one — so here even the 十割 really is safe, unlike almost every other soba shop. Tsuyu contains fish (魚介), so not vegan.

items.en: Cold soba with a hot dipping broth built on chopped duck and scorched spring onion

items.note: アレルゲン表：小麦・大麦 該当なし。Allergen chart clears wheat and barley; the tsuyu is the house gluten-free one. Duck and fish stock.

items.en: Hot soba with rice-flour prawn tempura
items.section: おそば クラシック Classic soba

items.en: Buckwheat 'dumpling' — soba flour and whole groats kneaded together and oven-roasted. The opener every course starts with
items.note: アレルゲン表：14品目すべて「該当なし」。The allergen chart shows all fourteen listed allergens 該当なし for this dish — the cleanest thing on the card. Price not published separately (it comes as the otoshi).

items.en: A slab of thick fried tofu from Fukuoka's celebrated Mihara Tofu, oven-crisped; eaten plain with ginger-soy or with toppings you choose
items.note: アレルゲン表：14品目すべて「該当なし」。生姜醤油は店のグルテンフリー醤油を指定のこと。Chart shows all fourteen 該当なし. It is served with ginger-soy — ask for the house gluten-free soy. Vegan only if you skip bonito-type toppings — ask.

items.note: アレルゲン表：14品目すべて「該当なし」、自家製めんつゆはグルテンフリー。Chart clears everything, and the house mentsuyu is the gluten-free one — ordinary natto sauce is soy-and-wheat, so this is a real distinction. Mentsuyu is dashi-based; ask about bonito for vegan.

items.en: Grilled Edomae nori from Funabashi Sanbanze, with real wasabi
items.note: 店が「お好みでグルテンフリーの醤油で」と明記。アレルゲン表は海苔の海老・蟹コンタミのみ、小麦・大麦なし。Shop explicitly offers its gluten-free soy with it; the only chart flag is a shrimp/crab cross-contact note on the nori itself. Plant-only.

items.en: Sliced kamaboko fish cake sent direct from Miyoshi Kamaboko in Yamaguchi — 100% domestic lizardfish — with wasabi
items.note: 店の表記「国産鮮魚エソ100%のグルテンフリーな蒲鉾」、アレルゲン表も小麦・大麦「該当なし」。The shop's own wording is 'gluten-free kamaboko'. Most kamaboko is bound with wheat starch, so this is a deliberate choice, and the chart backs it. Fish.

items.en: House paste of Ishino Saikyo miso and toasted buckwheat groats with nuts — built for sake
items.note: アレルゲン表：胡桃・蕎麦あり、小麦・大麦「該当なし」（西京味噌＝米味噌で麦味噌ではない）。Chart flags walnut and buckwheat but clears wheat and barley — Saikyo miso is a rice miso, not the barley 麦味噌 that would carry gluten. Walnut allergy warning.

items.ja: 酔っ払い鴨とあんぽ柿

items.ja: 尾崎牛もも肉炙りユッケ

items.en: Selected bluefin tuna in a fragrant garlic-chive soy
items.note: アレルゲン表（やま幸 鮪 ニラ醤油）：魚介のみ、小麦・大麦「該当なし」。Chart lists fish only; the nira-shoyu is made with the house gluten-free soy.

items.en: Aromatic herbs and moist steamed chicken in a light house dressing
items.note: アレルゲン表：鶏のみ、小麦・大麦「該当なし」。Chart flags chicken only — the dressing is wheat-free, which shop dressings usually are not.

items.ja: 大山鶏手羽一夜干し唐揚げ
items.en: Daisen chicken wings dried overnight in bone broth then fried until the skin shatters; Rokusuke salt and yuzu-kosho on the side
items.note: アレルゲン表：小麦・大麦とも「該当なし」（衣に小麦粉を使わず、フライヤーも米粉専用）。Karaage is normally wheat-dusted and fried in a shared wheat fryer; here the chart clears both wheat and barley. The salt is flagged 魚介.

items.ja: 里芋のスパイシーフライ
items.en: Whole taro deep-fried until crisp outside and sticky inside, Cajun-spiced and salted
items.note: アレルゲン表：小麦・大麦「該当なし」、魚介（ろく助の塩）あり。Chart clears wheat and barley; the Rokusuke salt carries a fish flag, so ask before calling it vegan.

items.ja: 米粉の天麩羅盛り合わせ
items.en: Rice-flour tempura assortment — startlingly light
items.note: 衣は米粉。アレルゲン表：海老・卵・魚介あり、小麦「該当なし」。Rice-flour batter, dedicated fryer; chart flags prawn, egg and fish but not wheat.

items.en: Prawn tempura, two pieces, in the rice-flour batter
items.note: アレルゲン表：海老・卵・魚介あり、小麦「該当なし」。Chart clears wheat.

items.ja: 野菜の天麩羅盛り合わせ
items.en: Vegetable tempura assortment
items.note: アレルゲン表：卵（天麩羅粉）・魚介（塩）あり、小麦「該当なし」。Chart clears wheat but flags egg in the batter, so vegetable does not mean vegan here.

items.en: Spicy pollock roe seared on the outside, still raw in the middle
items.note: アレルゲン表：魚介のみ、小麦・大麦「該当なし」。Mentaiko cure normally contains soy sauce; the chart here shows no wheat.

items.en: Shuto — bonito innards salted and aged for months into a dense, briny paste. A Kochi delicacy, eaten in tiny amounts with sake
items.note: アレルゲン表：魚介（鰹酒盗）のみ、小麦・大麦「該当なし」。Chart flags fish only.

items.en: Lightly pickled seasonal vegetables — the palate cleanser between dishes
items.note: アレルゲン表：14品目すべて「該当なし」。Chart shows all fourteen 該当なし — no soy-sauce brine, no dashi.

items.ja: 和牛ミスジしゃぶしゃぶ（野菜付き）
items.en: Misuji (top blade) wagyu swished through a salt broth built on the shop's soba dashi, with vegetables and house ponzu. Finish it with 〆の十割蕎麦 or 〆の更科蕎麦 at ¥715
items.note: アレルゲン表：牛のみ、小麦・大麦「該当なし」。スープもポン酢も店のグルテンフリー仕様。Chart flags beef only; the broth and the ponzu are both the house wheat-free versions.

items.ja: 特上牛タンしゃぶしゃぶ（野菜付き）
items.en: Thin-sliced premium beef tongue through the same soba-dashi salt broth — a texture you do not get from grilled tongue
items.note: アレルゲン表：牛のみ、小麦・大麦「該当なし」。Chart flags beef only.

items.en: Duck breast cooked low and slow, then finished over charcoal in the house yakitori tare
items.note: アレルゲン表：鴨・魚介（塩）のみ、小麦・大麦「該当なし」。自家製焼き鳥のタレもグルテンフリー。Yakitori tare is soy-and-mirin everywhere else; the chart shows this house version carries no wheat.

items.ja: 大山鶏もも肉醤油麹焼き
items.en: Chicken thigh marinated in shoyu-koji and grilled yuan-style — the soba shop's version of yakitori
items.note: アレルゲン表：鶏のみ、小麦・大麦「該当なし」。Shoyu-koji is normally wheat-fermented; the chart clears this one.

items.en: Wagyu sirloin with salt, real wasabi and a house onion sauce
items.note: アレルゲン表：牛・魚介（塩）のみ、小麦・大麦「該当なし」。Chart clears wheat and barley.

items.ja: 神戸牛溶岩焼きステーキ
items.en: Kobe beef cooked to your liking on a searing lava stone at the table
items.note: アレルゲン表に未掲載。Not on the published allergen chart (it is a newer addition). The kitchen is wheat-flour-free but confirm the sauce before ordering.

items.ja: 神戸牛・まぐろ・サーモン 手巻き寿司セット
items.en: Roll-your-own hand-roll set with Kobe beef, tuna and salmon
items.note: アレルゲン表に未掲載。付属の醤油の種類を要確認。Not on the published chart; the tuna hand-roll elsewhere on this menu contains wheat via smoked soy, so ask which soy comes with the set.

items.ja: 車海老の味噌漬け焼き
items.en: Tiger prawn marinated in miso and grilled crisp — shell, head and all, eaten whole
items.note: アレルゲン表：魚介のみ、小麦・大麦「該当なし」（麦味噌ではない）。Chart clears barley, i.e. the marinade is not 麦味噌.

items.en: Aged Awaji onion — sweet, soft, almost no bite — grilled and salted
items.note: アレルゲン表：魚介（ろく助の塩）のみ、小麦・大麦「該当なし」。Only the salt carries a fish flag — ask about it for vegan.

items.en: Aged Beniharuka sweet potato cooked slowly to candy sweetness, topped with a soy-derived 'butter'
items.note: アレルゲン表：14品目すべて「該当なし」。バターは大豆由来と店が明記。Chart shows nothing flagged and the shop states the butter is 大豆由来 (soy-derived) — so it is plant-based despite the name.

items.en: Lotus root griddled with the house gluten-free soy — still crunchy
items.note: 店が「グルテンフリーの醤油で香ばしく」と明記、アレルゲン表も14品目「該当なし」。Shop states the gluten-free soy by name and the chart flags nothing.

items.ja: 本鮪の手巻き（やま幸鮪の手巻き）
items.en: Hand-roll of raw Yamayuki bluefin with freshly grated wasabi, in smoked-nori vinegar rice
items.note: 店が商品説明に「※グルテンが入っています」と明記、アレルゲン表も燻製醤油による小麦を表示。The shop itself prints 'contains gluten' on this one item and the chart confirms wheat via the 燻製醤油 (smoked soy). The single deliberate exception on an otherwise wheat-free menu — do not assume, read the line.

items.en: Roughly chopped Yamayuki chutoro with takuan pickle in a hand-roll — the item the shop's Instagram is built on
items.note: アレルゲン表：魚介のみ（海苔に海老・蟹コンタミ表示）、小麦「該当なし」。Chart clears wheat — unlike the tuna hand-roll directly above it, which does not. Read carefully.

items.en: One-bite sushi pairing Ozaki beef with raw sea urchin
items.note: アレルゲン表：魚介・牛のみ、小麦「該当なし」。Chart clears wheat.

items.en: Toyosu-market raw sea urchin heaped into a hand-roll
items.note: アレルゲン表：魚介のみ、小麦「該当なし」。Chart clears wheat.

items.en: Wrapped in front of you: mochi and kibi-sugar bean paste from Nishi-Ogikubo's Echigo Tsuruya, around a seasonal fruit
items.section: 罪悪感のないスイーツ Guilt-free sweets
items.note: アレルゲン表：14品目すべて「該当なし」。Chart shows all fourteen 該当なし — so no wheat starch in the mochi, which is not a given. Ask whether the anko uses dairy before calling it vegan.

items.en: Kneaded to order from real warabi and lotus starch, with house Okinawan brown-sugar syrup and kinako
items.section: 罪悪感のないスイーツ Guilt-free sweets
items.note: アレルゲン表：14品目すべて「該当なし」。本わらび粉・蓮粉・黒糖・きな粉のみ。Chart flags nothing; ingredients are bracken starch, lotus starch, black sugar and soy flour. Most cheap warabimochi is potato-starch-and-wheat — this one is not.

items.en: Yame matcha from Fukuoka whisked at your table and poured over thick matcha ice cream
items.section: 罪悪感のないスイーツ Guilt-free sweets
items.note: アレルゲン表：胡桃（ヌガー）・乳（アイス）あり、小麦「該当なし」。Chart flags walnut in the nougat and dairy in the ice cream but no wheat. Not vegan.

items.ja: 本日の土鍋ご飯 炊き込みご飯（きのこ）
items.romaji: honjitsu no donabe gohan — takikomi gohan (kinoko)
items.en: A rice-bowl portion of the day's clay-pot rice — mushrooms cooked into the rice with aged bonito dashi. Add 漬物 pickles +¥330 or salmon and smoked daikon +¥880
items.note: アレルゲン表：魚介（鰹出汁）のみ、小麦・大麦「該当なし」。自家製のタレもグルテンフリー。Chart flags fish stock only; the seasoning tare is the house gluten-free soy.

items.en: Eight courses: roast sobagaki, the five-piece sobamae platter, seared Ozaki beef tartare, the day's sashimi, kitsune-yaki, miso-grilled tiger prawn, shoyu-koji chicken, then your choice of sarashina or juwari soba, finishing with matcha affogato
items.price: お料理のみ ¥6,600／飲み放題付き ¥8,000
items.note: コース中の蕎麦前盛り合わせのみアレルゲン表で大麦（山ウニ）「入っている」。他の構成品は小麦・大麦「該当なし」。Every course dish is cleared of wheat and barley by the shop's chart EXCEPT the sobamae platter, which carries barley via 山ウニ — ask them to substitute it. Two guests minimum, two-hour seating, 75-minute drink package.

items.ja: 特上牛タンしゃぶしゃぶコース
items.en: Six courses building to beef-tongue shabu-shabu, with the finishing soba and matcha affogato
items.price: お料理のみ ¥6,000／飲み放題付き ¥7,500
items.note: 同じく蕎麦前盛り合わせに大麦。Same barley caveat on the included sobamae platter — ask for a substitution; everything else is chart-clear.

items.ja: 和牛ミスジしゃぶしゃぶコース
items.en: Six courses building to misuji wagyu shabu-shabu, with the finishing soba and matcha affogato
items.price: お料理のみ ¥6,600／飲み放題付き ¥8,000
items.note: 同じく蕎麦前盛り合わせに大麦。Same barley caveat on the included sobamae platter.

tokyo_unagi_irokawa.price_note: Prices tax-included, from the shop's own Gnavi official page (gexc200.gorp.jp → r.gnavi.co.jp/0001033061/menu1). A user-logged Tabelog card from 2018 shows the same two sizes at ¥3,500 / ¥4,800, so the Gnavi figures are the newer ones. The shop's own page carries a stale ¥4,800 photo caption alongside the ¥4,900 table entry — take ¥4,900. Prices approximate — may change. Founded 1861; no reservations, cash, lunch only 11:30–14:00, closes when the eel runs out.

items.en: Charcoal-grilled eel over rice in a lacquered box, standard portion, with pickles and clear soup. The eel is steamed then grilled Tokyo-style, so it is soft rather than crisp, and painted repeatedly with a tare kept alive since 1861
items.note: 蒲焼のタレは醤油・味醂ベース＝小麦。The glaze is wheat soy sauce brushed on through the grilling; there is no gluten-free version. The 吸物 clear soup is also soy-seasoned.

items.en: The same box with a noticeably larger helping of eel — what most regulars order
items.note: 同じ醤油ベースのタレ＝小麦。Same wheat-soy tare.

items.en: Kabayaki — the glazed grilled eel served on its own, without the rice box, for eating with sake
items.note: 蒲焼＝醤油ダレ＝小麦。Wheat soy in the glaze.

items.en: Shirayaki — eel grilled plain with no glaze at all, eaten with wasabi and salt, or soy on the side. The way to taste the fish rather than the sauce
items.note: 白焼き自体は無味付けだが、つけ醤油は通常の小麦醤油。刷毛やグリルは蒲焼と共用。The eel itself is unglazed, which makes this the only possible route to eel here for a wheat avoider — but the dipping soy served alongside is ordinary wheat shoyu, so ask for salt and wasabi only. The grill is shared with the tare-painted kabayaki.

items.en: Boxes are available to take away — useful given the queue and the twelve seats
items.note: 同じ蒲焼＝小麦醤油。Same wheat-soy product. Listed on the shop's Gnavi page; no separate price published.

tokyo_bistro_fukushotei.price_note: Lunch board and the full drinks card read at full resolution from photographs of the shop's own printed cards dated 2026-01-06; the grill/main dishes from the shop's bound menu book photographed 2024-06. Both cards print ※価格は全て税込です. The 2026 lunch board is current; the 2024 mains may have drifted. The shop's own favy page (fukusyoutei.favy.jp) carries no menu at all.

items.ja: ワンプレートランチ（豚ヒレソテー・デミグラスソース）
items.romaji: one-plate lunch — buta hire saute, demi-glace
items.en: One-plate lunch: sautéed pork fillet under demi-glace, with rice, soup and salad on the same plate. The cheapest full meal in Asakusa's back streets
items.section: 本日のランチメニュー Today's lunch (2026-01 board)
items.note: デミグラスソースは小麦粉のルウが基本。Demi-glace is built on a wheat-flour roux — in a Japanese yoshoku kitchen it is essentially never gluten-free.

items.ja: ラーメンランチ（チキンカツと小ラーメン・ライスセット）
items.romaji: ramen lunch — chicken katsu to ko-ramen, rice set
items.en: Ramen lunch: a breaded chicken cutlet with a small bowl of ramen and rice. The shop traded as a Chinese diner before it became a bistro, and this plate is the leftover of that
items.section: 本日のランチメニュー Today's lunch (2026-01 board)
items.note: カツ＝パン粉、ラーメン＝小麦麺、スープも醤油。Breadcrumbed cutlet, wheat noodles and a soy broth — wheat three separate ways.

items.en: Pork loin cutlet on curry rice
items.section: 本日のランチメニュー Today's lunch (2026-01 board)
items.note: パン粉のカツ＋日本のカレールウ（小麦粉）。Panko cutlet plus Japanese curry roux, both wheat, plus a shared fryer.

items.en: Deep-fried breaded oysters — a winter-board item; with rice and soup, or on its own
items.section: 本日のランチメニュー Today's lunch (2026-01 board)
items.note: パン粉＝小麦、共用フライヤー。Panko breading and a shared fryer.

items.ja: ランチドリンクセット
items.en: Add a drink to any lunch: coffee (iced or hot), tea (iced or hot), hot au lait, iced au lait, cola, ginger ale, orange juice, apple juice, oolong tea, glass wine (red or white), or a glass of draught beer
items.section: 本日のランチメニュー Today's lunch (2026-01 board)
items.note: グラス生ビールを選ぶと麦芽＝グルテン。The draught-beer option is malt and never gluten-free; the juices and teas on the list are fine. Au lait options contain dairy.

items.ja: フロート各種（ブルーハワイ／コーヒー／コーラ）
items.en: Ice-cream floats — Blue Hawaii, coffee or cola
items.section: 本日のランチメニュー Today's lunch (2026-01 board)
items.note: アイスクリーム＝乳。Dairy ice cream.

items.ja: ハンバーグ デミグラスソース
items.en: Hamburg steak under demi-glace with vegetables — the yoshoku standard. Rice-and-soup set +¥200
items.section: グリル・洋食 Mains (menu book)
items.note: つなぎはパン粉、ソースは小麦ルウ。Panko binder in the patty and a wheat-roux sauce over it.

items.ja: ポークロースカツカレー
items.en: Pork loin katsu on curry rice, soup included
items.section: グリル・洋食 Mains (menu book)
items.note: パン粉＋カレールウ＝小麦。Panko and curry roux.

items.ja: 特製ハヤシライス オムレツ添え
items.en: The house hayashi rice — beef and onion in a dark, slightly sweet demi-glace — served with a plain omelette laid alongside. This is the dish reviewers come back for
items.section: グリル・洋食 Mains (menu book)
items.note: ハヤシのソースは小麦ルウ。The hayashi sauce is a wheat roux. The omelette itself is egg only, but it sits in the sauce.

items.en: Beef stew in the house dark sauce. Rice-and-soup set +¥200, or a baguette (thin- or thick-cut) +¥200
items.section: グリル・洋食 Mains (menu book)
items.note: シチューのルウ＝小麦、バゲット＝小麦。Roux-thickened, and the bread side is wheat.

items.ja: ポークソテー（デミグラス or ジンジャーソース）
items.en: Sautéed pork with a choice of demi-glace or ginger sauce. Rice-and-soup set +¥200
items.section: グリル・洋食 Mains (menu book)
items.note: デミグラスは小麦ルウ、ジンジャーソースは醤油ベース。Both choices carry wheat — the ginger sauce through soy sauce.

items.ja: チキンソテー（鶏むね肉）トマトソース
items.en: Sautéed chicken breast in tomato sauce — the lightest plate on the card
items.section: グリル・洋食 Mains (menu book)
items.note: トマトソースにルウを使わない店も多いが、当店は未公表。A plain tomato sauce need not contain wheat, and this is the only main here with a chance — but the shop publishes no ingredients and the kitchen is roux-heavy, so ask specifically about 小麦粉 and about the soup that comes with the set.

items.en: Starter plate — salami, prosciutto, potato salad and salad, with a baguette. Ordered before the mains by most evening diners
items.note: バゲット＝小麦。Comes with baguette. Cured meats often carry malt or soy seasoning. Price not printed on the photographed cards — read the board.

items.en: Asahi draught — medium or small
items.note: 麦芽＝グルテン。Barley malt.

items.en: Bottled Asahi
items.note: 麦芽＝グルテン。Barley malt.

items.en: House wine by the glass, red or white
items.note: ワインは小麦由来ではない。清澄剤は未公表。Wine is not wheat-based; fining agents are not published, which is what a strict vegan would want to ask about.

House sangria

items.ja: 焼酎（甲類）水割り／ウーロン茶割り／緑茶割り
items.en: Shochu with water, with oolong tea, or with green tea

items.note: 甲類焼酎は糖蜜原料が主だが銘柄未記載、麦焼酎を要確認。Korui shochu is usually molasses-based, but the brand is not stated and 麦焼酎 (barley shochu) must be ruled out — ask.

items.en: Lemon sour made with fresh lemon
items.note: ベース焼酎の原料未記載。Base spirit unspecified — confirm it is not barley shochu.
