tokyo_menya_kaijin_shinjuku.price_note: Prices tax-included (the page prints ※メニューは全て税込み価格です), straight from the shop's own menu page. This is the brand-wide card shared by the Shinjuku and Kichijoji branches — the shop publishes one menu rather than per-branch prices, so treat it as the Shinjuku card unless the counter says otherwise. Prices approximate — may change.

items.en: The house bowl and the reason the shop exists: a clear salt ramen whose broth is simmered from the bones, heads and collars — the ara — of whatever fish came in that morning, so it tastes different by season rather than by recipe
items.note: 中華麺は小麦。Wheat noodles, fish broth. Large size is free — say 大盛りで when you hand over the ticket.

items.ja: あら炊き塩らぁめん へしこ焼きおにぎり付き
items.romaji: ara-daki shio ramen, heshiko yaki-onigiri tsuki
items.en: The salt ramen with a grilled rice ball folded through with heshiko — mackerel cured for a year in rice bran. The intended move is to drop the rice ball into the leftover broth at the end and eat it as a porridge
items.note: 麺＝小麦、焼きおにぎりには醤油を塗る。Wheat noodles; the rice ball is soy-brushed before grilling. Heshiko is fermented mackerel.

items.ja: あら炊き辛塩らぁめん
items.en: The same fish-bone salt broth with chilli worked in. Heat is set at the counter: ちょい辛 mild ☆ / 中辛 medium ☆☆ / 辛塩 full ☆☆☆☆☆
items.note: 麺＝小麦。辣油・辛味噌にも小麦系調味料が入ることが多い。Wheat noodles, and chilli pastes commonly carry soy or wheat too.

items.ja: あら炊き辛塩らぁめん へしこ焼きおにぎり付き
items.romaji: ara-daki kara-shio ramen, heshiko yaki-onigiri tsuki
items.en: Chilli salt ramen with the heshiko grilled rice ball
items.note: 麺＝小麦、焼きおにぎりに醤油。Wheat noodles plus a soy-brushed rice ball.

items.en: Seasonal: chilled ramen built on asari clams (summer only)
items.section: 季節限定メニュー Seasonal
items.note: 価格は店頭表示のみ。The shop lists this without a price on its own page — read the board rather than guessing. Wheat noodles.

items.ja: 冷しはまぐりらぁめん
items.en: Seasonal: chilled ramen built on hamaguri hard clams (summer only)
items.section: 季節限定メニュー Seasonal
items.note: 価格は店頭表示のみ。No price published. Wheat noodles.

items.ja: トッピング ①海老つみれ ②鶏軟骨入りつくね ④水葉
items.romaji: topping — ebi tsumire / tori-nankotsu tsukune / mizuha
items.en: Toppings, first group: prawn ball, chicken meatball with cartilage worked through it, and greens
items.note: つみれ・つくねはつなぎに小麦粉やパン粉を使うのが一般的。Fish and chicken balls are usually bound with wheat flour or panko — ask. The greens alone are safe.

items.ja: トッピング ③白髪ねぎ ⑤岩手産三陸わかめ ⑥自家製塩味玉子
items.romaji: topping — shiraga-negi / Sanriku wakame / jikasei shio-ajitama
items.en: Toppings, second group: hair-fine shredded spring onion, Sanriku wakame seaweed from Iwate, and the house salt-cured soft-boiled egg
items.note: 味玉は「塩味」表記だが漬け地の詳細は未公表。Marinated ramen eggs are normally steeped in soy; this one is described as salt-cured (塩味玉子), which is promising but unconfirmed — ask. Negi and wakame are plant-only and wheat-free.

items.en: All six toppings at once
items.note: つみれ・つくね・味玉を含むため要確認。Includes the fish/chicken balls and the egg — ask.

items.en: Coriander, as much as they give you
items.note: 生の香草のみ。Fresh herb only.

items.en: Grilled rice ball mixed with heshiko, mackerel cured a year in rice bran. Salty, pungent and the thing to order if you only order one side
items.note: 焼きおにぎりは醤油を塗る＝小麦。へしこの漬け床にも調味料が入る。Soy-brushed before grilling; the heshiko cure carries seasonings too.

items.en: Small rice bowl topped with spicy pollock roe
items.note: 明太子の調味液には醤油・酒が入るのが一般的。The mentaiko cure normally contains soy sauce and sake — ask.

items.en: Heshiko over rice with hot tea or broth poured over — the traditional way this fish is eaten in Fukui
items.note: 出汁や茶漬けの素に醤油系調味料が入ることが多い。The pouring broth is very likely soy-seasoned — ask. Fermented fish.

items.en: Plain white rice, nothing on it
items.note: 白米のみ、味付けなし。Steamed rice with no seasoning at all — no wheat, no animal product. Worth knowing: it is the only thing on this card a coeliac can safely eat.

items.ja: ソーセージ（バジルウィンナーとチョリソー）
items.en: Two kinds of sausage on one plate, basil wiener and chorizo. Put there for the beer
items.note: ソーセージの結着材・調味料に小麦や麦芽由来のものが使われることがある。Sausage binders and seasonings often carry wheat or malt extract — ask.

items.en: Chopped raw octopus in wasabi — the default izakaya nibble
items.note: たこわさの調味には醤油や麺つゆが一般的。Usually seasoned with soy sauce or mentsuyu — ask.

items.en: Bottled beer
items.note: 麦芽＝グルテン。Barley malt.

items.en: Whisky highball
items.note: ウイスキー＝麦由来。Malt whisky base — not gluten-free.

items.en: Lemon sour
items.note: ベース焼酎の原料未記載、麦焼酎を要確認。Base shochu unspecified — rule out barley shochu.

items.en: Shochu lengthened with oolong tea
items.note: 同上、ベース焼酎の原料未記載。Same base-spirit question.

items.en: Oolong tea
items.note: 烏龍茶であり麦茶ではない。Oolong, not the barley tea (麦茶) that would carry gluten.

items.en: Cola

tokyo_et_vous.price_note: Prices approximate — may change. Course prices are from the shop's own lunch/dinner pages and are stated 税別 (BEFORE 10% tax); add ~10% at the till. Checked 2026-08-20. Dish compositions are the shop's own 一例 (sample line-up) — the actual plates change with the season.

items.en: Casual lunch course — hors d'oeuvre, then either potage or pasta, then a main you choose from the prix-fixe list
items.section: ランチコース Lunch courses (11:30–14:00 L.O.)
items.note: 税別. Prix-fixe: you pick the main. The pasta option and the bread are wheat; French sauces here are flour-thickened. Say 小麦アレルギー when booking.

items.en: Light lunch course — hors d'oeuvre, fish of the day, a main of your choice, dessert
items.section: ランチコース Lunch courses (11:30–14:00 L.O.)
items.note: 税別. Fish and meat throughout; French sauces normally contain flour and butter.

items.en: Special lunch course — amuse, hors d'oeuvre, potage, fish, a main of your choice, dessert
items.section: ランチコース Lunch courses (11:30–14:00 L.O.)
items.note: 税別. The published sample hors d'oeuvre plate explicitly names セモリナ小麦 (durum semolina) and クスクス (couscous) — both wheat.

items.ja: 大切な方との特別な日のコース
items.romaji: taisetsu na kata to no tokubetsu na hi no course
items.en: Special-occasion course (birthdays, anniversaries) — amuse, hors d'oeuvre, warm starter, fish of the day, meat, dessert, coffee or tea, petits fours
items.section: ランチコース Lunch courses (11:30–14:00 L.O.)
items.note: 税別. プティフール (petits fours) are baked wheat sweets.

items.en: Today's dessert with coffee or tea (lunch add-on)
items.section: ランチコース Lunch courses (11:30–14:00 L.O.)
items.note: 税別. Dessert changes daily; the shop's sample is クレームダンジュ (crémet d'Anjou — whipped fresh cheese), so dairy at minimum.

items.en: Light dinner course — hors d'oeuvre, fish of the day, a meat main of your choice, dessert, coffee or tea
items.section: ディナーコース Dinner courses (18:00–21:00 L.O.)
items.note: 税別. All dinner courses are prix-fixe on the meat.

items.en: Standard dinner course — amuse, hors d'oeuvre, potage, fish of the day, meat main of your choice, dessert, coffee or tea
items.section: ディナーコース Dinner courses (18:00–21:00 L.O.)
items.note: 税別. Some mains carry a supplement — see the meat list below.

items.en: Special dinner course — amuse, hors d'oeuvre, warm starter, fish of the day, meat main, dessert, coffee or tea, petits fours
items.section: ディナーコース Dinner courses (18:00–21:00 L.O.)
items.note: 税別.

items.en: EDO Cuisine course — the chef's Edo-Tokyo-meets-France menu: hors d'oeuvre, warm starter, fish of the day, meat, dessert, coffee or tea, petits fours. Signatures include 江戸前ぬた (fish and greens in vinegared miso) and steak glazed with 江戸甘味噌 sweet Edo miso
items.section: ディナーコース Dinner courses (18:00–21:00 L.O.)
items.note: 税別. 江戸甘味噌 and ぬた are miso preparations whose grain base is not declared, and the glazes use soy. Treat as wheat-containing.

items.ja: 旨味たっぷり地鶏もも肉のロティ エシャロットソース
items.romaji: jidori momoniku no roti, échalote sauce
items.en: Roast free-range chicken thigh with shallot sauce — a no-supplement main choice
items.note: Roast chicken is naturally wheat-free but the shallot pan sauce is a classic reduction; ask whether flour or soy goes in.

items.ja: 特選豚ロース肉のロースト 万久さんの味噌風味
items.romaji: tokusen buta rosu no roast, Mankyu-san no miso fumi
items.en: Roast selected pork loin finished with Mankyu's miso — a no-supplement main choice
items.note: Miso finish with the grain base undeclared, and glazes of this kind normally carry soy sauce. Treat as wheat.

items.en: Selected beef steak — a no-supplement main choice
items.note: Plain grilled beef; the sauce is the risk. The EDO Cuisine version is glazed with 江戸甘味噌.

items.ja: 仔羊のロースト 香味風味
items.en: Roast lamb with aromatics, seasonal vegetables and shallot sauce
items.note: Ask about the crust — French roast lamb is very often finished with a breadcrumb-herb crust.

items.ja: トロトロ和牛ほほ肉の赤ワイン煮込み
items.en: Wagyu beef cheek braised in red wine until it collapses
items.note: A red-wine braise is thickened with roux or a flour-dusted sear in nearly every French kitchen; assume wheat unless the chef says otherwise.

items.ja: 特選和牛肉のロースト／グリエ
items.en: Roast or grilled selected wagyu — the top main choice
items.note: The shop states the supplement differs by course.

items.ja: 北海道産メークインとセモリナ小麦・ワイルドライスのクリームグラタン
items.romaji: Hokkaido May Queen to semorina komugi, wild rice no cream gratin
items.en: Cream gratin of Hokkaido May Queen potato, semolina wheat and wild rice — a published sample hors d'oeuvre
items.price: コース内 (part of the course)
items.note: The shop's own text names セモリナ小麦 — durum wheat semolina. Explicit wheat, plus dairy cream.

items.ja: ひよこ豆とクスクスのタブレ
items.en: Chickpea and couscous taboulé — a published sample hors d'oeuvre
items.price: コース内 (part of the course)
items.note: クスクス is durum wheat. Otherwise plant-based; ask about the dressing.

items.ja: 小松菜とほうれん草のスムージー
items.en: Komatsuna and spinach smoothie — a published sample hors d'oeuvre item
items.price: コース内 (part of the course)
items.note: Greens as listed, but the shop does not say whether dairy or honey goes in. Ask.

items.ja: 自家製スモークサーモンとギリシャ風ピクルス〜白胡麻と豆腐のソース
items.romaji: jikasei smoked salmon to Girisha-fu pickles, shirogoma to tofu no sauce
items.en: House-smoked salmon with Greek-style pickles in a white-sesame-and-tofu sauce — a published sample dinner hors d'oeuvre
items.price: コース内 (part of the course)
items.note: The sauce is tofu and sesame rather than dairy — worth knowing if you avoid milk — but the cure and pickle liquor may carry soy sauce. Fish, so not vegan.

items.ja: クロダイと北海道産ホタテのポワレ 菜花のソース
items.romaji: kurodai to Hokkaido hotate no poêlé, nanohana no sauce
items.en: Pan-seared black sea bream and Hokkaido scallop with oven-roasted hakusai and maitake, rape-blossom sauce — a published sample fish course
items.price: コース内 (part of the course)
items.note: Poêlé fish is frequently floured before searing. Ask.

items.ja: クレームダンジュ〜ココナッツソース
items.en: Crémet d'Anjou — whipped fresh cheese and cream — with coconut sauce; a published sample dessert
items.price: コース内 (part of the course)
items.note: Fresh cheese and cream. Often plated on a biscuit or with a tuile — ask for it without.

items.ja: チョコレートのムース、赤葡萄のシャーベット〜木苺のソース仕立て
items.romaji: chocolate mousse, akabudou no sherbet, kiichigo sauce
items.en: Chocolate mousse with red-grape sorbet and raspberry sauce — a published sample dinner dessert
items.price: コース内 (part of the course)
items.note: Mousse is egg- and cream-based.

tokyo_sukemasa_coffee.price_note: Prices approximate — may change. From the shop's own MENU block at sukemasa.tokyo, marked in TAX (税込). Confidence is medium rather than high because the same page still carries a 緊急事態宣言 shortened-hours notice, so the list has not been revised in some years — expect the fruit sandwich in particular to have moved upward.

items.en: Espresso
items.note: Ground coffee and water, nothing else — no wheat ingredient and no animal product. The safe order at this counter.

items.en: Caffè latte, hot or iced — the shop's headline drink
items.note: Espresso and dairy milk only; no wheat ingredient in either. Not vegan, and no plant-milk option appears on the shop's own list.

items.en: Americano, hot or iced
items.note: Espresso plus hot water only.

items.en: Macchiato (hot only) — espresso marked with a spoon of milk foam
items.note: Coffee and a little dairy foam; no wheat ingredient.

items.en: Café mocha, hot or iced
items.note: The chocolate sauce is bought in and its maker is not stated; barley malt and wheat-derived thickeners turn up in these syrups. Ask.

items.en: Brûlée latte — a latte with a torched caramelised sugar crust, hot or iced
items.note: Caramelised sugar over dairy; ask what else is under the crust.

items.en: Calpis latte, iced — Japan's cultured-milk cordial shaken with milk
items.note: Calpis is a fermented-milk concentrate, so dairy. Ask about the base if you are strict on gluten.

items.en: Cocoa, hot or iced
items.note: Cocoa mix plus milk; the mix's allergen list is not published.

items.en: Apple juice
items.note: Bottled juice; brand not stated.

items.en: Orange juice
Ginger ale
Cola

items.ja: ハニーレモネード HOT/COLD
items.en: Honey lemonade, hot or iced
items.note: Honey — excluded by most vegans.

items.ja: ハチミツレモンスカッシュ
items.en: Sparkling honey-lemon squash
items.note: Honey.

items.en: Chai, hot or iced
items.note: Milk-brewed spiced tea. Ask whether a pre-mixed chai base is used.

items.en: Matcha latte, hot or iced
items.note: Café matcha is usually a pre-sweetened blend of undeclared composition; dairy milk.

items.en: Beer and other alcohol
items.note: Beer is malted barley — never gluten-free.

items.ja: 季節のフルーツサンド
items.en: Seasonal fruit sandwich — the shop's signature: whipped cream and cut seasonal fruit between crustless white shokupan
items.note: 食パン is wheat bread and the filling is dairy cream. This is what the queue is for, and it is emphatically not gluten-free.

items.en: Seasonal toast
items.note: Wheat bread.

items.en: Banana roll — a whole banana rolled in sponge with cream
items.note: Sponge is wheat flour and egg; cream is dairy.

items.en: Cookie
items.note: Wheat flour and butter.

items.en: Scone
items.note: Wheat flour, butter, milk.

items.en: Custard pudding
items.note: Egg, milk and sugar — usually no wheat in the custard itself, but a garnish biscuit is common. Ask for it plain.

items.en: Affogato — espresso poured over ice cream
items.note: Dairy ice cream; ask whether a wafer comes with it.

items.en: Chef's-whim sweet — whatever has been made that day
items.note: Changes daily; you have to ask on the day.

items.en: Set discount — order any food or sweet with a drink and the drink is ¥100 less
items.note: Printed under both the COFFEE and DRINK columns on the shop's menu.

tokyo_suke6_diner_sukeroku_din.price_note: Prices approximate — may change. Transcribed from the shop's own 2026 menu PDFs (the PLATES sheet is dated 2026-07-16 in its filename), all marked 表示価格はすべて税込 — tax included. Checked 2026-08-20. Open 8:00–18:00, closed Wednesdays; BREAKFAST is 8:00–11:00 and PLATES 11:00–18:00.

items.ja: イングリッシュ・ブレックファスト
items.en: English Breakfast — two fried eggs, house sausage and bacon, grilled tomato, greens, mushrooms, baked beans and toast, all in the pan
items.section: BREKKIE 朝ごはん (8:00–11:00, also on the all-day PLATES sheet)
items.note: Toast is wheat; house sausages are almost always rusk-bound; baked-bean sauce commonly carries wheat starch. Meat and egg.

items.en: Avocado toast on honey-quinoa bread with ripe avocado, dukkah spice, a poached egg and honey
items.note: ハニーキヌアブレッド is a wheat loaf with quinoa in it, not a quinoa-only bread. Egg and honey.

items.ja: 自家製グラノーラとフルーツのボウル
items.romaji: jikasei granola to fruits no bowl
items.en: House granola and fruit bowl with your choice of yoghurt or milk
items.note: House granola — oats are frequently milled alongside wheat and many granolas add barley malt; ask. Comes with dairy either way.

items.ja: モーニングセット（生ハムとモッツァレラ、ほうれん草のパニーニ＆チリビーンズスープ）
items.romaji: morning set — panini to chili bean soup
items.en: Morning set — prosciutto, mozzarella and spinach panini with chilli-bean soup, drip coffee included
items.note: Panini bread is wheat.

items.ja: 助六フレンチトースト
items.en: SUKE6 French toast on rye campagne — limited quantity daily
items.note: Rye campagne in a Japanese bakery is a rye-and-wheat loaf, and rye itself contains gluten. Egg and milk custard. Add-ons: natural ice cream +¥400, maple syrup +¥200, house jam +¥200.

items.en: One boiled egg — tell them how you want it done
items.note: A boiled egg in the shell: no wheat can reach it, and it is cooked in water not in the shared fryer. This is the safest hot item on the menu.

items.ja: 目玉焼き・スクランブル等（卵2個）
items.en: Two eggs fried your way — sunny side up, over easy, scrambled
items.note: Eggs and butter only, but cooked on the same flat-top as the bread and paninis. Ask for a clean pan if you are coeliac.

items.ja: クリーミーなオムレツ（卵3個）
items.en: Creamy plain omelette, three eggs
items.note: Add ham ¥150, cheese ¥150 or mushroom ¥200. Plain omelette has no wheat ingredient; shared cooktop.

items.en: Green salad (side)
items.note: The dressing is house-made and undeclared — Japanese house dressings very often contain soy sauce. Ask for oil and salt.

items.en: Roasted potato (side)
items.note: Roasted rather than deep-fried, so it avoids the shared fryer, but confirm the tray is not shared with breaded items.

items.en: Sautéed spinach (side)
items.note: Ask whether butter is used.

items.ja: 八幡平ジオファームのマッシュルームソテー
items.en: Sautéed Hachimantai Geo Farm mushrooms (side)
items.note: Named single-farm mushrooms. Ask about butter and whether soy sauce is used to finish.

items.en: Fried tomato (side)
Avocado (side)
items.note: Cut raw avocado — nothing added, nothing cooked.

items.ja: 自家製スモークベーコン
items.en: House-smoked bacon (side)
items.note: House cure of undeclared composition; cured meats in Japan often carry soy or wheat in the brine.

items.en: Smoked salmon (side)

items.ja: 助六スマッシュバーガー
items.en: SUKE6 smash burger — Australian barley-fed beef patty on a brioche bun with grilled onion, tomato and house chipotle mayo, salad and roasted potatoes
items.note: Brioche bun is wheat. Add cheese +¥250, bacon +¥350, avocado +¥300, a second beef patty +¥550. The shop announced a reworked burger recipe on 2026-07-21.

items.ja: ヴィーガン・グリルド・ケサディーヤ
items.en: Vegan grilled quesadilla — tortilla with vegan chilli beans, tomato, plenty of avocado, lettuce and red onion, with salad
items.note: The shop's own text calls it ビーガン and the beans ビーガンチリビーンズ. Wheat tortilla, so not gluten-free. If you add the optional cheese (+¥250) it stops being vegan.

items.ja: ベジタリアンチリビーンズ
items.en: Vegetarian chilli beans (snack portion)
items.note: The same beans the shop labels ビーガンチリビーンズ inside its vegan quesadilla, so plant-based by the shop's own wording. Ask about the spice blend if you need it wheat-free.

items.ja: フムスと野菜プレート
items.en: Hummus and vegetable plate with olives, vegetables and pickles, dusted with dukkah
items.note: Hummus and vegetables are plant-based, but dukkah blends sometimes include wheat crumb and pita often comes alongside. Ask for it without bread.

items.en: Niçoise salad — grilled Misaki tuna confit, soft-boiled egg, anchovy and greens
items.note: Egg and fish. The dressing is undeclared; anchovy pastes sometimes carry wheat.

items.en: Assorted house charcuterie
items.note: The kitchen makes its own hams and sausages; composition not published.

items.en: Marinated salmon
House pickles
items.note: Vinegar pickles; ask whether the liquor contains soy sauce.

items.ja: オリーブとドライトマトマリネ
items.en: Marinated olives and dried tomato
items.note: Olives, dried tomato and oil — no wheat ingredient and no animal product in any of the three.

items.en: Fried potato
items.note: Deep-fried in a fryer shared with breaded items in a bakery-attached kitchen — the classic cross-contamination trap. Plant-based but not safe for coeliacs.

items.ja: ギリシャ風チキンピタ ヨーグルトソース
items.en: Greek chicken gyros — house-made fluffy pita with garlic-and-oregano marinated chicken, red onion, cucumber, tomato and yoghurt sauce, salad and roasted potatoes
items.note: House pita is wheat; yoghurt is dairy.

items.ja: キューバンサンドイッチ 助六風
items.en: Cubano — soft bun with house pulled pork, prosciutto cotto, white cheese and pineapple tropical relish, salad and roasted potatoes
items.note: Wheat bun.

items.ja: カレー風味の国産生ソーセージホットドッグ
items.en: Asakusa Hot Dog! — domestic fresh salsiccia in a whole-wheat roll with curry-flavoured cabbage and onion fries, salad and roasted potatoes
items.note: Whole-wheat roll, plus curry powder and onion fries — several wheat routes at once.

items.ja: スパイシーなモロッコ風メルゲーズ オープンサンドイッチ
items.en: Moroccan merguez open sandwich — merguez sausage, chilli, spring onion and tomato on campagne bread
items.note: Campagne bread is wheat. Scrambled egg on top +¥300.

items.ja: キュウリと海苔のサンドイッチ
items.en: Cucumber and seaweed sandwich — cheese, sesame sauce and grain loaf, with salad and roasted potatoes; the shop admits it sounds odd and says the secret is sesame paste and soy sauce
items.note: Grain loaf is wheat AND the shop names お醤油 (soy sauce) in the sauce — wheat twice over. Cheese is dairy.

items.en: Croissant, baked by MANUFACTURE on the third floor
items.note: Wheat and butter. Both in-house bakeries were named to 食べログ パン TOKYO 百名店 2026.

items.en: Pain au chocolat
items.note: Wheat and butter.

items.en: Bagel
items.note: Wheat.

items.en: English bread — a slice of tin loaf, toasted or as it comes
items.note: Wheat.

items.ja: ライ麦のカンパーニュ スライス
items.en: Rye campagne, sliced
items.note: Rye is a gluten grain in its own right, and Japanese rye campagne is mostly wheat flour anyway.

items.ja: イングリッシュマフィン
items.en: English muffin
items.note: Wheat.

items.en: Biscuit (American-style)
items.note: Wheat and butter.

items.en: Waffle
items.note: Wheat batter.

items.en: Caramel pudding
items.note: Egg and milk custard; usually no wheat but made in a bakery kitchen.

items.ja: 抹茶のシフォンケーキ
items.en: Matcha chiffon cake
items.note: Chiffon is wheat flour and egg.

items.en: Gâteau au chocolat
items.note: Some gâteau au chocolat recipes are flourless and some are not — ask, do not assume.

items.ja: 焼きドーナツ バニラアイス添え
items.romaji: yaki donut, vanilla ice cream soe
items.en: Baked doughnut with vanilla ice cream
items.note: Wheat.

items.ja: 本日のナチュラルアイスクリーム
items.en: Today's natural ice cream, from KIKI Natural Ice Cream
items.note: Flavour changes daily; dairy.

items.ja: コーヒー HOT/ICED（ミカフェート）
items.en: Drip coffee, hot or iced — MI CAFETO beans, Rainforest Alliance certified; the Eatgood Blend is 90% Brazil, 10% Thailand (Doi Tung)
items.note: Coffee and water only. Soy milk is free (+¥0), oat milk +¥150 — the oat milk is the one to query if you are coeliac, since oats are routinely cross-contaminated with wheat.

items.en: Espresso
items.note: Coffee and water only.

items.en: Café latte, hot or iced
items.note: No wheat ingredient. Swap to soy milk at no charge to make it vegan (oat milk +¥150).

items.ja: エスプレッソ・トニック
items.en: Espresso tonic
items.note: Espresso over tonic water.

items.ja: 自家製ジンジャーエール HOT/ICED
items.en: House ginger ale — organic Shimanto ginger with organic Kikaijima cane sugar, hot or iced
items.note: The shop names both ingredients and their farms; ginger, cane sugar and water, nothing malted.

items.ja: 自家製レモネード HOT/ICED
items.en: House lemonade — unsprayed lemons with Kikaijima cane sugar, hot or iced
items.note: Lemon, cane sugar, water — the shop names all three.

items.ja: アーノルド・パーマー
items.en: Arnold Palmer — house lemon syrup with Earl Grey
items.note: Tea, lemon syrup and water; no malt.

items.ja: グリーン・スムージー
items.en: Green smoothie
items.note: Composition unpublished — ask whether yoghurt or honey goes in.

items.ja: 自家製トマトジュース
items.en: House tomato juice
Fresh-squeezed juice
items.note: Squeezed to order.

items.ja: ヒノキ・レモングラス ハーブティー
items.en: Hinoki-and-lemongrass herbal tea from noi, the Mt Fuji wild-aroma brand — caffeine free
items.note: Cypress and lemongrass infusion — a genuinely unusual drink and one of the few things here with nothing in it at all.

items.ja: フレンチ・アールグレイティー HOT/ICED
items.en: French Earl Grey, hot or iced — organic tea hand-blended in Melbourne by a naturopath-founded brand
items.note: Leaf tea.

items.ja: カフェインフリー・チャイティー HOT
items.en: Caffeine-free chai, hot
items.note: Caffeine-free chai bases are usually rooibos and spice, but barley is sometimes used as a body. Ask.

items.en: Sencha green tea, hot — from Susumuya Chaten
items.note: Leaf green tea. Note this is 煎茶, not 麦茶 — the barley tea you get free elsewhere in Japan is not gluten-free and this is.

items.ja: ピルスナー・ウルケル（ミルコ／ハラディンカ／ナドバクラット）
items.romaji: Pilsner Urquell — MLÍKO / HLADINKA / NA DVAKRÁT
items.en: Pilsner Urquell poured three Czech ways: MLÍKO 'milk' all-foam (450ml ¥700 / 700ml ¥1,000), HLADINKA smooth and NA DVAKRÁT crisp (both 450ml ¥990 / 700ml ¥1,380)
items.note: Barley beer. Never gluten-free, whichever way it is poured.

items.ja: アサヒ・スーパー・ドライ（生）
items.en: Asahi Super Dry on tap
items.note: Barley beer.

items.en: Beer of the day from Barbaric Works, the Chigasaki brewery
items.note: Craft barley beer.

items.ja: アサヒ・ドライ・ゼロ
items.en: Asahi Dry Zero non-alcoholic beer
items.note: Alcohol-free but still a malt drink — not gluten-free.

items.en: SUKEROKU — the house signature: a hot cocktail of Jameson, walnut and espresso
items.note: Jameson is a barley-and-wheat whiskey. Distilled spirits are gluten-free by most standards but coeliac guidance in Japan is conservative; treat as unsafe if you react to distillates.

items.en: AGEMAKI — ginger and tequila, named like its sibling after a character from the Sukeroku kabuki play
items.note: Tequila is agave-based and the mixer is the shop's own ginger syrup — no grain anywhere in it. The one signature cocktail a coeliac can order.

items.en: IKYU — Aperol, bourbon and lemon
items.note: Bourbon is distilled from a corn-and-rye mash.

items.ja: クラフト ジントニック
items.en: Craft gin and tonic — Sipsmith London dry gin with premium tonic
items.note: Sipsmith is distilled from wheat spirit; distilled, but ask if you are strict.

items.ja: キューカンバー・モヒート（ノンアルコール）
items.en: Cucumber mojito, alcohol-free
items.note: Cucumber, mint, lime and soda.

items.ja: アペロール・スプリッツ
items.en: Aperol spritz
items.note: Flagged gluten-free during research with no reason recorded, so downgraded to "ask" on merge. Plain rice and similar are usually fine, but confirm the seasoning and the serving scoop.

items.en: Oriol Rossel Brut cava, Spanish sparkling
items.note: Grape wine. Fining agents in wine are occasionally animal-derived.

items.en: Fresh mimosa — sparkling wine with fresh orange

items.ja: グラスワイン 赤／白
items.en: Glass wine, red or white — bottles by request, ask staff for the list
items.note: The bottle list is verbal, not printed.

items.ja: 玉露 芋焼酎（鹿児島）
items.en: Gyokuro sweet-potato shochu from Kagoshima
items.note: 芋焼酎 is distilled from sweet potato with rice koji — importantly NOT 麦焼酎, which is barley. This is the shochu to order; if a bar offers you 麦焼酎 instead, that one is barley.

items.ja: 嘉之助 シングルモルト
items.en: Kanosuke single malt whisky
items.note: Malted barley, distilled. Yamazaki 12 and Hakushu 12 are ¥2,500 each; Yoichi and Miyagikyo ¥1,000 each.

tokyo_sizzler_shinjuku_toho_bu.price_note: Prices approximate — may change. Read off the chain's own menu PDFs, the grand menu revised 2026-06-23 and re-uploaded 2026-06-24 (the chain posted a グランドメニュー改定 notice that day). Each price is shown 税別 then 税込 — the 税込 figure in brackets is what you pay. The morning buffet PDF is the branch-specific 新宿東宝ビル店 sheet. Checked 2026-08-20. Prices are chain-wide except the morning buffet, which is this branch only.

items.ja: シズラー プレミアムサラダバー
items.en: The Premium Salad Bar on its own — 70-plus items, unlimited refills: seasonal vegetables, deli salads, soups, fruit, pasta, tacos, desserts and soft drinks. Comes with the cheese toast
items.note: This is the reason to come, and it is also a buffet: shared tongs across 70 trays, pasta and tacos in the line, soy-based dressings. There is plenty a vegan can eat but nothing a coeliac should trust. The chain says an アレルギー物質一覧表 (allergen table) is kept at the store — ask for it at the door.

items.en: Salad bar, ages 3–6
items.note: Same buffet, child price. Same buffet caveats.

items.ja: チャイルドサラダバー（7〜12歳）
items.en: Salad bar, ages 7–12

items.ja: シニアサラダバー（65歳以上）
items.en: Salad bar, 65 and over
items.note: Bring ID; the weekday-lunch senior rate is notably cheaper.

items.ja: シズラーチーズトースト
items.en: Sizzler Cheese Toast — thick-cut bread spread with parmesan and griddled to golden brown. The 50-year-old American recipe the chain is famous for; it comes free with every salad bar
items.price: サラダバーに付属（ランチエクスプレスのみ1枚 ¥84／税込 ¥92）
items.section: シズラーチーズトースト Cheese Toast
items.note: Wheat bread and parmesan. The single most-photographed item here and completely off-limits gluten-free.

items.en: Lunch Express — weekday-only cut-price salad bar: two plates plus one dessert cup, unlimited drinks and soup
items.note: The chain states the cheese toast is NOT included in this one — it is ¥84 (税込 ¥92) a slice. Two plates only, so plan them.

items.ja: モーニングビュッフェ（新宿東宝ビル店限定）
items.en: Breakfast Buffet — this branch only, 6:30–10:30 (last admission 10:00, stay until 10:30). Cheese toast is griddled to order and free, but you have to ask for it
items.note: A Kabukicho hotel breakfast buffet in the Hotel Gracery building. Same shared-tongs problem as the day buffet.

items.en: Ribeye steak 150g — Australian beef delivered chilled and cut by hand in-store, seared hot. Salad bar for one included
items.note: The beef itself is plain grilled, but you pick a sauce — of the five offered only ミントソース (yoghurt and mint) and the plain steak avoid an obvious wheat route. わさび醤油 is soy sauce, i.e. wheat; ドミグラス (demi-glace) is a flour-based brown sauce; グリーンチリペッパーソース is built on gravy. Ask for it sauceless.

items.en: Ribeye steak 300g, salad bar included
items.note: Gram weights are pre-cooking. Same sauce caveat.

items.en: Ribeye steak 450g — a full pound, an inch thick, salad bar included
items.note: Same sauce caveat.

items.ja: シズラーハンバーグステーキ
items.en: Hamburger steak — 100% beef patty served spitting on a hot iron plate, salad bar included
items.note: Japanese ハンバーグ is bound with panko breadcrumb and is served under a demi-glace; assume wheat in both the patty and the sauce.

items.ja: ハンバーグ＆シュリンプグリル
items.en: Hamburger steak with four grilled prawns, salad bar included
items.note: Patty binder as above. Pick two sauces.

items.ja: ハンバーグ＆ロブスター
items.en: Hamburger steak with lobster, salad bar included

items.ja: ハンバーグ＆BBQポークスペアリブ 2P
items.romaji: hamburger steak & BBQ pork spare ribs 2P
items.en: Hamburger steak with two BBQ-glazed pork spare ribs, salad bar included
items.note: The chain flags that the BBQ sauce contains honey (so not vegan either); BBQ sauces are also a standard soy-sauce and wheat-starch vehicle.

items.ja: ハンバーグ＆リブロースステーキ150g
items.en: Hamburger steak plus a 150g ribeye — the beef-lover's combo, salad bar included

items.ja: ハンバーグ＆ラムチョップグリル
items.en: Hamburger steak with grilled Australian lamb chops, salad bar included
items.note: Mint sauce is the recommended pairing and is the one flour-free sauce on the board.

items.ja: リブロースステーキ150g＆ロブスター
items.en: Ribeye 150g with lobster, salad bar included
items.note: You choose two sauces — see the sauce note on the plain ribeye.

items.ja: リブロースステーキ150g＆牡蠣と帆立貝柱のグリル
items.en: Ribeye 150g with four steamed oysters and four Hokkaido scallops, salad bar included

items.ja: リブロースステーキ150g＆シュリンプグリル
items.en: Ribeye 150g with four grilled prawns, salad bar included

items.ja: リブロースステーキ150g＆サーモンのグリル
items.en: Ribeye 150g with grilled fatty salmon, salad bar included

items.ja: サンタフェチキン＆マリブチキン
items.en: Sizzler Classics — Santa Fe chicken (Mitsuse chicken marinated in chilli, coriander and lime, grilled) alongside Malibu chicken (breaded fried chicken topped with ham and cheese), a recipe as old as the chain
items.note: マリブチキン is 衣をつけてフライした — battered and deep-fried, so wheat in the coating and a shared fryer. The Santa Fe half alone would be a better bet, but they arrive on one plate.

items.ja: サンタフェチキン＆ポップコーンシュリンプ
items.en: Santa Fe chicken with popcorn shrimp
items.note: Popcorn shrimp is battered and fried.

items.ja: リブロースステーキ150g＆マリブチキン
items.en: Ribeye 150g with Malibu chicken — Sizzler USA's long-running seller
items.note: Breaded chicken.

items.ja: みつせ鶏もも肉のグリル
items.en: Grilled chicken thigh — Mitsuse chicken raised in the mountains of northern Kyushu, delivered chilled, served with grilled lemon and fresh salsa
items.price: 平日ランチ ランチグリルセット ¥2,220 (税込 ¥2,442) / 1tripサラダバー付 ¥3,080 (税込 ¥3,388) / サラダバー1名付 ¥4,010 (税込 ¥4,411)
items.section: LUNCH PICK-UP GRILLS 平日ランチ (11:00–15:00)
items.note: Grilled, not breaded, and dressed with salsa rather than a brown sauce — the most plausible gluten-free main in the building, but confirm the marinade.

items.ja: シーフードプラッター
items.en: Seafood platter — one lobster, four prawns, four Hokkaido scallops and four steamed oysters, salad bar included
items.note: All grilled or steamed rather than fried; the butter sauces are the thing to query.

items.ja: シズリング ケイジャンシュリンプグリル
items.en: Sizzling Cajun grilled shrimp — six prawns spitting in Cajun spice
items.note: Cajun spice blends occasionally use wheat flour as a carrier. Ask.

items.ja: 牡蠣と帆立貝柱のグリル＆シュリンプのグリル
items.en: Four steamed oysters, four Hokkaido scallops and four prawns, all grilled, salad bar included
Grilled salmon with fresh salsa, salad bar included
items.note: Salsa rather than a flour sauce — a reasonable ask-and-order.

items.ja: チキン＆シュリンプファヒータ
items.en: Chicken and shrimp fajitas — grilled in Mexican spice with peppers and onion, four tortillas, with salsa, avocado dip, sour cream, coriander and lime
items.note: Fajita tortillas in Japan are wheat flour tortillas, not corn. Sour cream is dairy.

items.ja: ビーフ＆シュリンプファヒータ
items.en: Beef and shrimp fajitas, four tortillas with the same toppings
items.note: Wheat tortillas.

items.ja: ポップコーンシュリンプ
items.en: Popcorn shrimp — bite-size battered prawns, faintly spicy on the finish
items.note: Battered and deep-fried. The chain notes appetizers can only be ordered alongside a grill or the salad bar.

items.ja: フライドポテト〜トリュフソルト＆パルミジャーノ・レッジャーノ〜
items.romaji: fried potato — truffle salt & Parmigiano Reggiano
items.en: French fries with truffle salt and Parmigiano Reggiano grated to order (plain fries ¥650 / 税込 ¥715)
items.note: The chain prints 揚げ油は使い分けておりません — the frying oil is NOT separated between items. Everything from this fryer is cross-contaminated with the breaded chicken and shrimp. Parmesan is dairy.

items.ja: ソフトシェルシュリンプ
items.en: Fried soft-shell shrimp — caught just after moulting, so the shell is soft enough to eat whole
items.note: Deep-fried in the shared oil.

items.en: Orange chicken — American-Chinese fried chicken in a sweet-tart orange sauce
items.note: Battered, fried, and the orange sauce is soy-and-cornstarch based.

items.ja: 追加：リブロースステーキ150g／BBQポークスペアリブ1P／ラムチョップグリル1P
items.romaji: add on — ribeye 150g / BBQ pork spare rib 1P / grilled lamb cutlet 1P
items.en: Add-ons to any grill: ribeye 150g ¥1,920 (税込 ¥2,112), one BBQ pork spare rib ¥830 (税込 ¥913), one grilled lamb cutlet ¥1,390 (税込 ¥1,529)
items.note: The BBQ rib's sauce contains honey by the chain's own note.

items.ja: 追加：ロブスター／牡蠣と帆立貝柱／シュリンプグリル
items.romaji: add on — lobster / oysters & scallops / grilled shrimp
items.en: Seafood add-ons: lobster ¥2,130 (税込 ¥2,343), grilled oysters and scallops ¥1,970 (税込 ¥2,167), grilled shrimp ¥1,260 (税込 ¥1,386)

items.ja: ランチグリルセット／1tripサラダバー／サラダバー1名様付き
items.romaji: lunch grill set / 1 trip salad bar / salad bar for one
items.en: Weekday lunch structures: ランチグリルセット is the grill with one soup, two drinks and rice or bread; 1trip サラダバー adds one plate one visit to the bar for +¥860 (税込 ¥946); サラダバー1名様付き gives the full bar plus cheese toast for +¥1,790 (税込 ¥1,969)
items.note: Only the full サラダバー付き option includes the cheese toast; the 1-trip option does not.

items.ja: ソース各種（ドミグラス／グリーンチリペッパー／ベアルネーズ／ミント／わさび醤油）
items.romaji: sauces — demi-glace / green chili pepper / béarnaise / mint / wasabi-shoyu
items.en: Choose your steak sauce, no charge: demi-glace, green chilli pepper (a gravy base with green chilli and mustard), béarnaise (butter and herb), mint (mint in yoghurt), or wasabi-soy. Potato on the side: mashed, baked or fries
items.note: わさび醤油 is wheat soy sauce — flatly not gluten-free. ドミグラス is a flour-thickened brown sauce and グリーンチリペッパー is built on gravy, so both are suspect. ミントソース (yoghurt) and ベアルネーズ (egg and butter) are the two with no obvious wheat route, but all five are dairy or egg or soy — none is vegan.

items.ja: ハートランド生ビール
items.en: Heartland draft beer, by the glass or the pitcher
items.note: Barley beer — never gluten-free. Kirin Ichibanshibori 500ml bottle ¥730 (税込 ¥803); Heineken 330ml ¥690 (税込 ¥759).

items.ja: キリン グリーンズフリー
items.en: Kirin Greens Free — alcohol-free beer-taste drink, three hops, 334ml bottle
items.note: Alcohol-free but still a malt-and-hops beverage. Not gluten-free.

items.ja: ハウスワイン テヌータ・サン・マルコ（赤・白）
items.romaji: house wine — Tenuta San Marco (red / white)
items.en: House wine from Cantine Due Palme: red is a Salento Negroamaro (medium body, red-fruit nose, firm tannin), white a Salento Malvasia (dry, citrus and white flowers)
items.note: Grape wine — no grain. Fining agents may be animal-derived, which is the only vegan question.

items.en: Bottle list: Robert Mondavi Woodbridge Pinot Noir ¥3,130 (税込 ¥3,443), Casillero del Diablo Sauvignon Blanc ¥3,130, Mondavi Private Selection Bourbon-Barrel Cabernet ¥5,130 (税込 ¥5,643), Mondavi Private Selection Vint Chardonnay ¥4,130 (税込 ¥4,543), Château Reysson Bordeaux ¥3,730 (税込 ¥4,103), Capetta Brut Spumante ¥2,280 (税込 ¥2,508)
items.note: The bourbon-barrel Cabernet is aged in whiskey wood but is still grape wine.

items.en: Two-hour free-flow plan — Heartland draft, Heineken, house wine, sparkling wine, plus the non-alcoholic Greens Free, MOCK Bar and zero-alcohol sparkling
items.note: Beer is in the plan, so the plan as a whole is not gluten-free even though the wines are. Everyone at the table must order it (children excepted); last orders five minutes before time.

items.ja: モクバル／スパークリング アルコールゼロ
items.romaji: MOCK Bar / Sparkling Wine Non Alcohol
items.en: MOCK Bar mocktails (pear-and-pine or orange-and-mango mix, 250ml) and alcohol-free sparkling in white or rosé (360ml)
items.note: Fruit and de-alcoholised grape — unlike the non-alcoholic beer, these carry no malt. Soft drinks otherwise live on the salad bar and are included with it.

tokyo_etsuno_injoy.price_note: Prices approximate — may change. Taken from the shop's own メニュー page, checked 2026-08-20.

items.en: Shojin dandan noodles — the house signature. Spiced sesame-and-chilli broth over wheat noodles, built without sugar, without alcohol and without the five pungent roots (garlic, onion, leek, chive, asafoetida) that Buddhist temple cooking forbids
items.note: 小麦麺＝グルテン。店の表記：砂糖・アルコール・五葷不使用のオリエンタルビーガン。Wheat noodles. Fully vegan — a pure shojin kitchen, so no bonito dashi, no egg, no dairy anywhere in the house.

items.en: Shojin hot-and-sour noodle soup — sharp vinegar-and-pepper broth with silky sheets of yuba (tofu skin) over wheat noodles; lighter and more refined than the usual Chinese version
items.note: 小麦麺＝グルテン。Wheat noodles; the thickening is potato starch. Vegan (no animal stock).

items.en: Shojin stone-bowl bibimbap — coloured vegetables and grated mountain yam on rice in a sizzling stone bowl; mix it hard with the house-made gochujang before eating
items.note: 自家製コチュジャン。コチュジャンは麦芽・小麦を含むことが多い＝要確認。Gochujang normally contains barley malt or wheat, house-made or not — ask. Vegan and five-pungent-free by house rule.

items.ja: トリュフ香る、森のグリーンパスタ
items.romaji: truffle kaoru, mori no green pasta
items.en: 'Forest green pasta' scented with truffle — a green herb-and-vegetable pasta finished with truffle aroma
items.note: パスタ＝小麦。Wheat pasta. Careful: the shop's own page repeats the bibimbap blurb under this dish (template copy-paste), so the printed description is not reliable — ask what is actually in it. Vegan by house rule.

items.ja: バジル醤油ソースの山伏茸土鍋ご飯
items.romaji: basil shoyu sauce no yamabushitake donabe gohan
items.en: Clay-pot rice with lion's-mane mushroom in a basil-soy sauce — cooked to order in a donabe and opened at the table; the most expensive lunch plate
items.note: 醤油＝小麦。Soy sauce is wheat-based unless a tamari is named, and none is — assume gluten. The shop's page repeats the bibimbap blurb here too. Vegan.

items.en: Shojin udon set — wheat udon in a plant-based broth with the accompanying small dishes
items.note: うどん＝小麦、つゆも醤油ベース。Udon and the soy-based tsuyu are both wheat. Vegan — kombu/shiitake dashi only, never bonito.

items.en: 'Rainbow' dinner course, 9 dishes: tea from 200-year-old trees / thick spinach soup / creative kaiseki appetisers with a tofu dish / deep-fried vegetable-and-mushroom kabura roll / plum-enzyme juice / seasonal takikomi rice / medicinal yojo soup / seasonal fruit and tea jelly
items.note: コース内容は季節により変更。揚げ物の衣・調味の醤油に小麦の可能性大＝要確認。The fried roll and the soy seasoning almost certainly carry wheat — raise it when you book. Dinner is reservation-only, by 15:00 the previous day. Alcohol-free house.

items.en: 'Heaven and earth' dinner course, 10 dishes: pu-erh from 200–500-year-old trees / thick spinach soup with steamed yamato-imo / shin'etsu kaiseki appetisers with a tofu dish / morel-and-cucumber soup / vegetable-and-mushroom yuba roll / the house raw-enzyme drink / seasonal takikomi rice / bamboo-fungus yojo soup / seasonal fruit and tea jelly
items.note: コース内容は季節により変更。醤油・とろみ粉に小麦の可能性＝要確認。Reservation-only, by 15:00 the previous day.

items.en: Shojin sweets for the tea hour — house sesame dumplings, mooncake, the flaky 巻雲酥 pastry, house shojin cheesecake, and a tea jelly made with Taiwanese high-mountain tea
items.note: 月餅・巻雲酥・焼菓子はいずれも小麦生地。Mooncake, kenunso and the baked sweets are all wheat doughs. All vegan (no egg, no dairy). In-store prices are not published; the retail packs run ¥880–¥6,980.

items.en: Kenunso — flaky layered Chinese pastry, the shop's tea-time speciality, sold as a retail box
items.note: 小麦生地＝グルテン。Wheat pastry. Vegan.

items.ja: 悦納｜桂花蓮子百合とハトムギの粽
items.romaji: keika renshi yuri to hatomugi no chimaki
items.en: Chimaki — a bamboo-leaf parcel of sticky rice with osmanthus, lotus seed, lily bulb and Job's-tears. One piece
items.note: ハトムギは名前に「麦」が付くが植物学的には麦類ではない。ただし国内流通品は麦類と共用ラインで加工されるのが一般的。Job's tears is not botanically wheat or barley despite the 麦 in its name, but Japanese supply is routinely processed on shared barley lines — do not treat it as gluten-free.

items.ja: 悦納｜芳醤仕立て山伏茸の粽
items.en: Chimaki with lion's-mane mushroom in a fragrant fermented-bean sauce. One piece
items.note: 芳醤（醤ベースの調味料）は小麦を含むものが一般的。Bean-paste seasonings of this type contain wheat unless stated otherwise.

tokyo_tempura_nakasei.price_note: Prices approximate — may change. From the shop's own お料理 page, tax included; a 10% service charge is added on top. Checked 2026-08-20.

items.en: Raijin-age — the dish to order here. A thick kakiage fritter of shiba-ebi shrimp and aoyagi clam adductors, named by the French scholar Dr Yutaka Tatsuno for its likeness to the thunder-drum carried by the Raijin statue at Kaminarimon. Sold as a single fritter
items.note: かき揚げ衣＝小麦粉、天つゆ＝醤油。Wheat batter, wheat-soy dipping sauce, shared fryer. Shellfish.

items.en: Deluxe tempura set — two kuruma prawns, kisu whiting, conger eel, megochi flathead, squid and other fish of the season, with rice, miso soup and pickles. Hall chair seats only, no reservations taken
items.note: 衣＝小麦、天つゆ＝醤油。All wheat batter; if barley matters, ask which miso is in the soup.

items.en: Tempura set — two kuruma prawns, kisu whiting, conger eel and a small shiba-ebi kakiage, with rice, miso soup and pickles
items.note: 衣＝小麦、天つゆ＝醤油。

items.en: Raijin-age set — the shrimp-and-clam signature fritter with rice, miso soup and pickles
items.note: 衣＝小麦、天つゆ＝醤油。

items.en: Deluxe tendon — two kuruma prawns, kisu, conger, megochi, squid and seasonal fish over rice with the sweet soy tare
items.note: 衣＝小麦、天丼たれ＝醤油・味醂。

items.note: そうめん＝小麦、茶碗蒸しと煮物の出汁に醤油。The somen course is wheat and the dashi-based plates carry soy. Add ¥1,000 to upgrade the sashimi to an assortment. Contents shift with the day's delivery.

items.en: Shusai course — the drinker's course: the same first plate, two kinds of sashimi, salt-grilled summer ayu, and hand-made satsuma-age
items.section: 今月のコース Monthly courses
items.note: さつま揚げ＝すり身に小麦澱粉が入るのが一般的、揚げ物。Fish cake and deep-frying. +¥1,000 upgrades the sashimi; +¥500 adds a rice or noodle finish; +¥500 swaps the ayu for Okinawan rafute.

items.en: Special course — mozuku, the first plate, three kinds of sashimi, Yonezawa beef roast-beef salad, chilled summer-vegetable nimono, hamo tempura, then a choice of corn rice / Inaniwa udon / ochazuke, and home-made melon sherbet
items.section: 今月のコース Monthly courses
items.note: 天ぷらとうどんは小麦、煮物と天だしに醤油。Tempura and udon are wheat; the nimono and tentsuyu carry soy.

items.en: Goya chanpuru — crunchy bitter melon stir-fried with pork luncheon meat, island tofu, carrot and egg. The shop's summer signature
items.section: 今月の郷土料理 This month's regional dishes
items.note: かつお出汁で味を付ける、ポークランチョンミートと卵入り。The shop states it is seasoned with bonito dashi; luncheon meat and egg. Seasonal — August 2026.

items.en: Thin-sliced bartail flathead sashimi — a fish the shop calls 'the fugu of summer', firm white flesh with home-made ponzu
items.section: 今月の郷土料理 This month's regional dishes
items.note: 自家製ポン酢＝醤油ベース。The house ponzu is soy-based. The fish alone is untreated; ask for salt instead. Seasonal.

items.en: Grilled American aubergine with a thick coat of sesame miso and a green chilli
items.section: 今月の郷土料理 This month's regional dishes
items.note: 胡麻味噌の味噌種別と出汁の有無が未記載。The sesame-miso coating's miso type is unpublished, and dengaku miso is often loosened with dashi — ask on both counts. Seasonal.

items.en: Chilled summer vegetables simmered and served cold — winter melon, kabocha, aubergine, okra, corn, tomato
items.section: 今月の郷土料理 This month's regional dishes
items.note: 煮汁＝出汁と醤油。Simmering liquid is dashi and soy. Seasonal.

items.ja: 生とうもろこし ピュアホワイト
items.en: Raw Pure White sweetcorn from Gunma — sweet enough to eat uncooked, and served that way
items.section: 今月の郷土料理 This month's regional dishes
items.note: 生のとうもろこしのみ、調味なし。Raw corn, cut and served with nothing on it — no sauce, no dashi, no coating. Seasonal.

items.en: Salt-grilled summer ayu (sweetfish), served with tade vinegar
items.section: 今月の郷土料理 This month's regional dishes
items.note: 魚は塩焼きだが、添えの蓼酢の調味が未記載。The fish is salt-grilled only, but the tade-su it comes with is unpublished — ask, or have it without. Seasonal.

items.en: Raw rock oyster from the Seto Inland Sea — a big one, dressed simply with ponzu
items.section: 今月の郷土料理 This month's regional dishes
items.note: ポン酢＝醤油ベース。Served with soy-based ponzu; ask for lemon instead and the oyster itself is clean. Seasonal.

items.ja: 季節のうまいもん盛合せ
items.en: Assorted seasonal delicacies — six small things; in August 2026, Sado mozuku, sweetcorn, pressed aji sushi and three others
items.section: とりあえず ちょっと Starters
items.note: 棒寿司の酢飯・もずく酢に醤油が入る。The pressed sushi and the vinegared mozuku both carry soy; contents change monthly.

items.en: Sesame tofu — hand-made, dense and chewy, under a spoon of sesame paste
items.section: とりあえず ちょっと Starters
items.note: 葛と胡麻が主だが、上がけの餡に出汁・醤油が入ることが多い。Sesame tofu itself is kudzu starch and sesame, but the sauce over it usually carries dashi and soy — the menu calls it a sesame starchy sauce. Ask.

items.en: Green soybeans in the pod — the shop rotates whichever variety is in season
items.section: とりあえず ちょっと Starters
items.note: 塩茹でのみ。Salt-boiled pods, nothing else added — the one dish on this menu with no sauce, no dashi and no coating.

items.ja: きゅうり一本漬（わさび）
items.en: A whole lightly-pickled cucumber with wasabi — house-made, and sharp
items.section: とりあえず ちょっと Starters
items.note: 自家製浅漬けだが漬け地の調味が未記載。House shallow-pickle; the pickling liquor is unpublished and often contains soy or dashi — ask.

items.en: Whole baby horse mackerel deep-fried and steeped in seasoned vinegar
items.section: とりあえず ちょっと Starters
items.note: 南蛮酢＝醤油ベース、揚げ物。Nanban vinegar is soy-based and the fish is deep-fried.

items.en: Green salad with the house Japanese-style dressing
items.section: とりあえず ちょっと Starters
items.note: 和風ドレッシング＝醤油ベースが標準。A 和風 dressing is soy-based by definition, and usually carries dashi. Ask for oil and salt instead.

items.en: Sado mozuku seaweed in vinegar — thicker strands than usual, with a crunch
items.section: とりあえず ちょっと Starters
items.note: もずく酢の三杯酢＝醤油と出汁。The sanbaizu dressing is soy and bonito dashi.

items.ja: ポテトサラダ（ポークランチョンミート入り）
items.en: House potato salad with pork luncheon meat; the topping changes monthly
items.section: とりあえず ちょっと Starters
items.note: マヨネーズ（卵）とポークランチョンミート。Mayonnaise and luncheon meat; the meat's binder is unpublished.

items.ja: 米沢牛ローストビーフサラダ
items.en: Yonezawa beef roast-beef salad, accented with the house garlic soy
items.section: とりあえず ちょっと Starters
items.note: 特製にんにく醤油＝小麦。The menu names the accent as a garlic soy sauce.

items.en: Seared dried ray fin — the classic sake snack, with mayonnaise and Naito-togarashi shichimi
items.section: とりあえず ちょっと Starters
items.note: 干しエイヒレの調味と七味の増量剤が未記載。Dried ray fin is often seasoned with mirin/soy before drying, and shichimi blends can carry additives — ask. Mayonnaise contains egg.

items.en: Uncoloured spicy cod roe from Hakata's famous Fukuya
items.section: とりあえず ちょっと Starters
items.note: 明太子の調味液に醤油・酒が入るのが一般的。Mentaiko is cured in a soy-and-sake liquor as a rule — ask Fukuya's spec.

items.en: Shuto — bonito guts salted and fermented with yeast and sake; crunchy, intensely salty, meant to be eaten a smear at a time
items.section: とりあえず ちょっと Starters
items.note: 酒と酵母で仕上げるが、市販品は調味料に小麦を含むことがある。Made with sake and yeast, but commercial shuto often carries wheat in the seasoning — ask.

items.en: Value sashimi assortment — whatever came in that day, air-freighted from Ehime or bought at Toyosu. 大 large / 小 small
items.note: 小 ¥2,750。魚自体は無加工、つけ醤油＝小麦。The fish is untreated; only the dipping soy is wheat.

items.ja: 本日の刺身盛合せ 一人前
items.en: Today's sashimi assortment, one portion
items.note: つけ醤油＝小麦。Only the dipping soy is the problem.

items.en: Octopus sashimi from the Seto Inland Sea — the shop says the flavour builds the more you chew it
items.note: つけ醤油＝小麦。Boiled octopus, sliced; only the dipping soy is wheat.

items.ja: 天ぷら盛合せ（海老・白身魚・野菜 他）
items.en: Assorted tempura — prawn, white fish and seasonal vegetables, fried to order
items.note: 天ぷらの衣＝小麦、天つゆ＝醤油、共用フライヤー。Wheat batter, soy dipping broth, shared fryer.

items.ja: 夏野菜の天ぷら盛合せ（ゴーヤ・茄子・かぼちゃ 他）
items.en: Summer-vegetable tempura — bitter melon, aubergine, kabocha and others
items.note: 衣＝小麦、天つゆ＝醤油・出汁。Wheat batter and dashi-soy dip. Seasonal.

items.ja: 手作り さつま揚げ
items.en: Hand-made satsuma-age — the shop's most-ordered dish, ground and fried in-house each day and served straight out of the oil. Sweet and strongly flavoured, aimed squarely at shochu
items.note: すり身のつなぎに小麦澱粉、味付けに醤油、揚げ物。Fish-paste binder plus soy seasoning, deep-fried.

items.en: Fried chicken with ginger and garlic in the marinade
items.note: 下味に醤油、衣に粉、共用フライヤー。Soy marinade, flour coating, shared fryer.

items.en: Zenmaru shiitake steak — thick, juicy caps treated like a steak
items.note: ステーキソース・仕上げの調味が未記載。The finishing sauce is unpublished; a shiitake 'steak' is usually finished with butter and soy — ask.

items.ja: 焼茄子 愛媛 絹かわなす
items.en: Roasted Ehime kinukawa aubergine — sweet, soft, melting
items.note: 焼茄子は出汁と生姜醤油、鰹節を添えるのが定番。Yakinasu is normally served with dashi, ginger-soy and bonito flakes — the menu does not say. Ask.

items.en: Salt-grilled Miyazaki jitokko chicken — a slow-reared bird; the skin is crisped hard to lock the juice in
items.note: 塩焼きでタレを使わない。Grilled with salt only, no tare — the shop names it 塩焼 and describes only salt. Confirm nothing is brushed on and that it does not share a grill with the teriyaki items.

items.en: The house rolled omelette — sweet, moist and heavy on dashi. The shop calls it the comforting one
items.note: 出汁がきいた玉子焼き＝出汁に醤油が入るのが一般的。Dashi-rich rolled omelette; dashi seasoning normally includes light soy — ask. Egg.

items.en: Rafute — skin-on Okinawan pork belly simmered over a full day in Ryukyu awamori and black sugar until it parts under chopsticks
items.note: ラフテーの煮汁は泡盛・黒糖に加え醤油が入る。Rafute's braise is awamori and black sugar over a soy base.

items.en: Clams steamed in sake — in season and full
items.note: 酒蒸しは酒と塩のみの場合と、醤油を落とす場合がある。Sake-steaming can be sake and salt alone, or finished with a splash of soy — ask which they do.

items.en: Today's ara-ni — fish heads and collars simmered sweet and salty. The fish changes daily
items.note: 甘辛く炊く＝醤油と味醂。Sweet-salty simmer means soy and mirin.

items.en: Inaniwa udon from Sato Yosuke, the old Akita house — hand-finished strand by strand, served in the shop's own dashi. Also on the menu chilled
items.note: うどん＝小麦、つゆ＝出汁と醤油。Wheat noodles and dashi-soy broth. 冷やし稲庭うどん also ¥880.

items.en: Chilled Gassan somen from Yamagata — the summer default finisher
items.note: そうめん＝小麦、めんつゆ＝醤油。Wheat noodles, soy dipping broth. Seasonal.

items.en: Corn rice — sweetcorn cooked into the rice, with miso soup
items.note: 炊き込み御飯の調味に醤油が入るのが一般的、味噌汁の出汁も鰹。Takikomi rice is normally seasoned with soy, and the soup that comes with it is bonito dashi — ask. Seasonal.

items.en: Garlic rice made with the house soy-pickled garlic — a quiet regulars' favourite, served with soup
items.note: にんにくの醤油漬けを使う＝小麦。The menu says outright it is built on soy-pickled garlic.

items.ja: 牛しぐれ煮ご飯（小丼・汁付）
items.en: Small beef bowl — sweet-salty simmered beef over rice dusted with Edo's own Naito-togarashi chilli, with soup
items.note: しぐれ煮＝醤油と生姜。Shigureni is a soy-and-ginger simmer.

items.ja: お茶漬け（のり・明太子・梅干しからお選び下さい）
items.en: Ochazuke — rice under bonito dashi steeped with hojicha; choose nori, mentaiko or umeboshi
items.note: 鰹だしにほうじ茶をくぐらせた出汁。Bonito-dashi base, and the dashi will carry soy; mentaiko adds its own.

items.ja: 美味しい コシヒカリ
items.en: A bowl of Niigata Koshihikari — refills allowed
items.note: 白飯のみ、調味なし。Plain steamed rice, nothing added.

items.en: Miso soup with clams
items.note: 味噌の種別未記載。Miso type unpublished — ask, as a 麦味噌 would be barley. Clams.

items.en: Assorted pickles from the shop's own nuka bed
items.note: 自店のぬか床。A rice-bran bed is not itself wheat, but shops often feed the bed with soy — ask.

items.ja: 自家製 メロンシャーベット
items.en: Home-made melon sherbet, made from whole melons
items.note: メロンを丸ごと使った手づくりシャーベット。The shop states it is whole melon — a sorbet, not an ice cream, so no dairy and no wheat. Confirm no dairy is added.

items.ja: 自家製 甘夏シャーベット
items.en: Home-made amanatsu citrus sherbet
items.note: 甘夏をたっぷり使った手づくりシャーベット。Fruit sorbet, no wheat; confirm no dairy.

items.ja: 自家製 苺アイスクリーム
items.en: Home-made strawberry ice cream, made from whole strawberries
items.note: アイスクリーム＝乳製品。No wheat, but this one is an ice cream, so dairy — not vegan, unlike the two sherbets.

items.en: Kurawanka bento — 20 a day only; sashimi, a grilled dish, a simmered dish and more in one box. The lunch everyone orders
items.note: 煮物・焼物の味付けに醤油。The simmered and grilled compartments are soy-seasoned. Lunch is weekdays 11:30–14:30 only; not served weekends or holidays.

items.ja: ゴーヤーチャンプル定食
items.en: Goya chanpuru set — the seasonal lunch
items.note: かつお出汁とポークランチョンミート。Bonito dashi and luncheon meat. Seasonal.

items.en: Ginger pork set — the big one
items.note: 生姜焼のタレ＝醤油・味醂。Ginger-pork sauce is soy and mirin.

items.en: Greedy set — pick any two of grilled fish, sashimi and ginger pork
items.note: 生姜焼のタレとつけ醤油。Depends what you pick, but soy is in all three routes.

items.ja: ごま香る！りゅうきゅう定食
items.en: Ryukyu set — the Miyazaki fishermen's dish: sashimi and offcuts marinated in sesame and soy, piled on rice
items.note: りゅうきゅうは醤油の漬けダレが定義。The dish is by definition a soy marinade.

items.en: Today's ara-ni set — fish simmered soft, the fish changing by the day
items.note: 煮汁＝醤油と味醂。Sweet-soy simmer.

items.en: Lunch-only course, booking required — three starters, sashimi, a grilled dish, a simmered dish, rice and miso soup or chilled udon, dessert
items.note: うどん＝小麦、煮物・焼物に醤油。Udon is wheat; the cooked plates are soy-seasoned. Give a day's notice and they will swap the grilled or simmered course for satsuma-age.

items.ja: 手取川 山廃純米（石川）
items.en: Tedorigawa yamahai junmai, Ishikawa — Gohyakumangoku rice. 1合 flask or a 4合 bottle
items.note: 純米＝米と米麹のみ。Junmai is rice and rice koji only; no allergen line is published. 四合瓶 ¥4,290。

items.en: Denshu junmai, Aomori — Hanafubuki rice
items.note: 純米＝米と米麹のみ。四合瓶 ¥5,280。

items.en: Nanbu Bijin special junmai, Iwate
items.note: 特別純米＝米と米麹。四合瓶 ¥6,050。

items.en: Urakasumi junmai, Miyagi
items.note: 純米＝米と米麹。四合瓶 ¥4,730。

items.en: Koshi-no-Kagetora 'Ryu' honjozo, Niigata — the cheapest flask on the list
items.note: 本醸造は醸造アルコール添加（サトウキビ由来が一般的）。Honjozo has added distilled alcohol, normally cane-derived, not grain — but it is unlabelled. 四合瓶 ¥2,640。

items.en: Kokuryu daiginjo, Fukui — Yamada Nishiki, 300ml bottle
items.note: 大吟醸＝高精白の米。Highly polished rice. 300ml bottle price.

items.en: Tenbi special junmai, Yamaguchi
items.note: 特別純米＝米と米麹。四合瓶 ¥5,280。

items.en: Tsukasabotan 'Senchu Hassaku' junmai, Kochi — the dry one built for fish
items.note: 純米＝米と米麹。四合瓶 ¥4,510。

items.en: Nakanaka barley shochu, Miyazaki, 25% — 140ml carafe
items.note: 麦焼酎＝大麦。Barley shochu. 720ml瓶 ¥5,500。

items.en: Hyakunen no Kodoku — the cult barrel-aged barley shochu, 40%
items.note: 麦焼酎＝大麦。Barley shochu, barrel-aged. 720ml瓶 ¥12,100。

items.ja: 野うさぎの走り（宮崎 42度）
items.en: Nousagi no Hashiri rice shochu, Miyazaki, 42%
items.note: 米焼酎＝米と米麹。Rice shochu, but unlabelled. 600ml瓶 ¥7,590。

items.en: Kujira sweet-potato shochu, Kagoshima, 25%
items.note: 芋焼酎でも麹に米か麦を使う。Sweet-potato base, but the koji grain is unpublished — ask. 720ml瓶 ¥4,950。

items.en: Sato Kuro — the black-koji sweet-potato shochu everyone knows
items.note: 黒麹＝米麹が一般的だが未記載。Black koji is normally grown on rice, but not stated. 720ml瓶 ¥6,380。

items.en: Dabada Hiburi chestnut shochu, Kochi
items.note: 栗焼酎だが麹は穀物。Chestnut-based, but the koji is a grain — ask which. 720ml瓶 ¥4,950。

items.en: Kikaijima brown-sugar shochu — the cheapest carafe on the list
items.note: 黒糖焼酎は米麹使用。Brown-sugar shochu is fermented on rice koji. 720ml瓶 ¥4,400。

items.en: Seifuku awamori from Ishigaki, 30%
items.note: 泡盛＝タイ米と黒麹。Awamori is long-grain rice and black koji — no wheat or barley in the recipe, but unlabelled. 600ml瓶 ¥3,300。

items.en: COEDO Ruri craft pilsner, small bottle
items.note: 麦芽＝大麦。Barley malt.

items.en: Shinjuku Pale Ale — a local craft beer, small bottle
items.note: 麦芽＝大麦。Barley malt.

items.ja: キリン 一番搾り / アサヒ スーパードライ / サッポロ 黒ラベル / エビス / サントリー ザ・プレミアム・モルツ
items.en: Bottled beer — Kirin Ichiban Shibori, Asahi Super Dry, Sapporo Black Label, Yebisu or Suntory Premium Malt's, medium bottle. All the same price
items.note: 麦芽＝大麦。All barley malt.

items.ja: サントリー オールフリー
items.en: Suntory All-Free — alcohol-free beer, small bottle
items.note: ノンアルコールでも麦芽由来。Alcohol-free but still brewed from malt.

items.en: Sakurao Gin Original, single — one of the two gins the shop is pushing this month
items.section: ジン・ウイスキーなど Spirits
items.note: ジンのベーススピリッツが穀物由来の場合がある。Gin's base spirit is often grain — distilled, but ask if you are strict. ボトル ¥7,150。

items.en: Hakkaisan 'ohoro' gin from the Niseko distillery, single
items.section: ジン・ウイスキーなど Spirits
items.note: ベーススピリッツ未記載。Base spirit unpublished. ボトル ¥16,500。

items.en: White Horse whisky, single
items.section: ジン・ウイスキーなど Spirits
items.note: ウイスキー＝大麦。Barley whisky.

items.en: Super Nikka whisky, single
items.section: ジン・ウイスキーなど Spirits
items.note: ウイスキー＝大麦。Barley whisky.

items.en: Suntory Ao or Chita whisky, single
items.section: ジン・ウイスキーなど Spirits
items.note: ウイスキー＝穀物。Whisky, grain-based.

items.ja: レモン酎ハイ / シークヮーサー酎ハイ
items.en: Lemon or shikuwasa shochu highball
items.section: ジン・ウイスキーなど Spirits
items.note: ベース焼酎の種類が未記載。Base shochu unpublished — ask it is not a 麦 base.

items.ja: 白鶴 蔵元仕込み 梅酒
items.en: Hakutsuru brewery-made plum wine, 80ml carafe
items.section: ジン・ウイスキーなど Spirits
items.note: 梅酒のベース酒が日本酒か焼酎かで変わる。Umeshu's base is either sake or shochu — ask which, since a barley shochu base would carry gluten.

items.ja: シャルドネ マクファーソン・ファミリー・ヴィンヤーズ
items.en: McPherson Family Vineyards Chardonnay, by the glass
items.note: ぶどうのみで穀物不使用。Wine involves no cereal at any stage. Fining agents may be animal-derived, so vegan is not assured. ボトル ¥4,950。

items.ja: シラーズ ビン・トリプルファイブ ジョージ・ウィンダム
items.en: George Wyndham Bin 555 Shiraz, by the glass
items.note: ぶどうのみ。No cereal; fining agents unpublished. ボトル ¥4,950。

items.ja: 勝沼 甲州ブラン 単一畑 東圃場
items.en: Katsunuma Torii-daira single-vineyard Koshu Blanc — the Japanese white, full bottle
items.note: ぶどうのみ。Japanese Koshu grape; no cereal.

items.ja: スーパールイボスティー
items.en: Super rooibos tea, 350ml carafe
items.section: ソフトドリンク Soft drinks
items.note: ルイボスは穀物ではない。Rooibos is a leaf infusion, not a cereal — unlike 麦茶.

items.ja: 沖縄シークヮーサージュース
items.en: Okinawan shikuwasa citrus juice
items.section: ソフトドリンク Soft drinks
items.note: 果汁。Fruit juice.

items.en: Apple juice
items.section: ソフトドリンク Soft drinks
items.note: 果汁。Fruit juice.

items.en: Oolong tea
items.section: ソフトドリンク Soft drinks
items.note: 茶葉のみ。Tea leaves only — oolong, not 麦茶 barley tea.

items.ja: プレミアム・ジンジャーエール
items.en: Premium ginger ale
items.section: ソフトドリンク Soft drinks
items.note: 生姜と炭酸。Ginger and carbonated water.

items.ja: フィーバーツリー トニックウォーター
items.en: Fever-Tree tonic water
items.section: ソフトドリンク Soft drinks
items.note: キニーネと糖の炭酸水。Quinine and sugar in carbonated water.

items.ja: 富士ミネラル / ウィルキンソン タンサン
items.en: Fuji still mineral water ¥495, or Wilkinson sparkling ¥440
items.section: ソフトドリンク Soft drinks
items.note: 水のみ。Water. Wilkinson ¥440, Fuji Mineral ¥495.

tokyo_niigata_jizake_to_shunko.price_note: Prices approximate — may change. From the shop's own official Gnavi pages (g087438.gorp.jp is the shop's site; the menu pages live at r.gnavi.co.jp/0000038287/menu1–8), checked 2026-08-20. The shop is a Niigata regional izakaya three minutes from Shinjuku-sanchome on the Suehirotei street; the sake list is the real draw — over thirty Niigata flasks, several of them 地元限定 bottles rarely poured in Tokyo.

items.en: Assorted delicacies — the shop's own recommendation: firefly squid in soy, Kasuke-san's squid shiokara, and flounder-fin tartare, three on a plate
items.section: お酒のお友 With a drink
items.note: 沖漬け＝醤油漬け。The 沖漬け component is squid cured in soy by definition.

items.en: Namero — raw fish chopped on the board with miso and spring onion until it turns to paste
items.section: お酒のお友 With a drink
items.note: 味噌の種類が未記載。Namero is fish and miso — ask which miso, as a 麦味噌 would be barley.

items.en: Flounder-fin 'yukke' — the fatty fin muscle dressed Korean-style with sesame oil and egg yolk
items.section: お酒のお友 With a drink
items.note: ユッケのタレ＝醤油・コチュジャン。Yukke dressing is soy, and gochujang carries wheat. Raw egg yolk.

items.en: Firefly squid cured whole in soy
items.section: お酒のお友 With a drink
items.note: 沖漬け＝醤油漬け。Okizuke means cured in soy sauce.

items.en: Seared beef tongue
items.section: 香ばしき 焼き物 Grilled
items.note: 味付けが未記載（塩かタレか）。The menu does not say whether it is salted or tare-glazed — ask for 塩.

items.en: Chicken meatball skewers, two — tare or salt, your choice
items.section: 香ばしき 焼き物 Grilled
items.note: つくねのつなぎに小麦、タレ＝醤油。Tsukune uses a wheat or starch binder and the tare is soy; even the salt version shares the tare grill.

items.en: Seared dried ray fin with mayonnaise — the classic thing to chew while drinking
items.section: 香ばしき 焼き物 Grilled
items.note: 干しエイヒレの下味が未記載。Dried ray fin is often pre-seasoned with mirin and soy — ask. Mayonnaise contains egg.

items.en: Dashi-rolled omelette, served straight out of the pan while it is still fluffy
items.section: 香ばしき 焼き物 Grilled
items.note: 出汁巻きの出汁に薄口醤油が入るのが一般的。The dashi is normally seasoned with light soy — ask. Egg.

items.en: Grilled shishamo smelt, three fish, roe in
items.section: 香ばしき 焼き物 Grilled
items.note: 塩干しを焼くだけ。Salt-cured and grilled, no sauce applied. Ask that nothing is brushed on and that the grill is not shared with tare skewers.

items.ja: 北海道 氷下魚炙り焼き（3尾）
items.en: Grilled Hokkaido komai (saffron cod), three
items.section: 香ばしき 焼き物 Grilled
items.note: 干物を炙るだけ。A dried fish, grilled plain — but it will arrive with mayonnaise or soy on the side, which are not.

items.en: House menchi-katsu — breaded minced-meat patty, deep-fried
items.note: パン粉＝小麦、共用フライヤー、ソースも小麦。Breadcrumbs, shared fryer, wheat sauce.

items.en: Chikuwa fish tube fried in a green-nori batter — the textbook version
items.note: 磯辺揚げの衣＝小麦、ちくわのつなぎにも澱粉。Wheat batter, and the chikuwa itself carries starch binder.

items.en: Assorted tempura — the shop suggests it alongside the hegi soba
items.note: 衣＝小麦、天つゆ＝醤油。Wheat batter, soy dip.

items.en: Agedashi tofu with nameko mushrooms — a big seller here
items.note: つゆ＝出汁と醤油、共用フライヤー。Dashi-soy broth and a shared fryer.

items.ja: 栃尾の油揚げ（ねぎ味噌／納豆）
items.en: Tochio abura-age — Niigata's astonishing 5cm-thick fried tofu slab, grilled and filled with either spring-onion miso or natto. Half or full size
items.section: 新潟こだわり料理 Niigata specialities
items.note: ねぎ味噌の味噌種別、納豆のタレが未記載。¥580 is the ねぎ味噌 half; full size also available. Ask which miso, and whether the natto comes with its soy tare.

items.en: Noppe — the Niigata New Year dish: root vegetables simmered together, made whenever a crowd gathers
items.section: 新潟こだわり料理 Niigata specialities
items.note: 煮汁＝出汁と醤油、貝柱やいくらが入ることも。Dashi-and-soy simmer, and noppe usually carries dried scallop or salmon.

items.en: Echigo free-range chicken cutlet skewers, two, with curry sauce
items.section: 新潟こだわり料理 Niigata specialities
items.note: 衣＝パン粉、カレーソース＝小麦ルウ。Breadcrumbs and a wheat-roux curry sauce.

items.ja: のど黒 姿 漁師煮付け／天然塩炙り焼き
items.en: Whole nodoguro (blackthroat seaperch) sent up from Niigata — simmered fisherman-style, salt-grilled, or as sashimi. Size varies with the catch
items.section: 新潟こだわり料理 Niigata specialities
items.note: 煮付けは甘辛い濃い醤油味＝小麦。塩炙りなら塩のみ。The shop states the 煮付け is a strong sweet-soy simmer — that one is out; the 天然塩炙り焼き salt-grilled version is the one to ask for. Price from ¥2,200 for a whole fish.

items.ja: 新潟地魚ぼんや自慢！あら煮大根
items.en: The house ara-ni — fish collars and heads simmered sweet and salty with daikon. A best-seller; extra daikon ¥100 a slice
items.section: 新潟こだわり料理 Niigata specialities
items.note: 甘辛な醤油の味付けと店が明記。The shop states outright it is a sweet-salty soy seasoning.

items.en: Seared Koshi-no-tori, the Niigata heritage chicken
items.section: 新潟こだわり料理 Niigata specialities
items.note: 味付けが未記載。Seasoning not stated — ask for 塩 rather than tare.

items.ja: 越の鶏「モモ肉」ジューシー唐揚げ
items.en: Fried Koshi-no-tori thigh — a best-seller, served straight out of the oil
items.section: 新潟こだわり料理 Niigata specialities
items.note: 下味に醤油、衣に粉、共用フライヤー。Soy marinade, flour coating, shared fryer.

items.ja: 佐渡一夜干しスルメ烏賊 炙り焼き
items.en: Overnight-dried Sado squid, seared — the shop says the Sado squid stays soft
items.section: 新潟こだわり料理 Niigata specialities
items.note: 一夜干しは塩水に浸けて干すのみ。An overnight-dry is brine and air, then a grill — no soy in the process. The mayonnaise and soy that arrive alongside are not; keep them off.

items.ja: 佐渡 丸干し烏賊（肝入り）炙り焼き
items.en: Whole sun-dried Sado squid with the liver left in, seared. Made for sake
items.section: 新潟こだわり料理 Niigata specialities
items.note: 生烏賊を肝ごと天日干しにしただけ、と店が明記。The shop states it is raw squid sun-dried with the liver in — nothing added. Ask for it without the soy on the side.

items.ja: かすけさんちの イカ塩辛
items.en: Kasuke-san's hand-made squid shiokara, made with no additives at all
items.section: 新潟こだわり料理 Niigata specialities
items.note: 「添加物一切不使用」と店が明記。The shop states no additives whatsoever, which makes wheat unlikely — but shiokara is often finished with a splash of sake or soy, so ask the maker's spec before relying on it.

items.en: Mentaiko cured with kanzuri — the Myoko chilli paste fermented in snow with sea salt, yuzu and koji. Mellow heat and a yuzu finish; a best-seller
items.section: 新潟こだわり料理 Niigata specialities
items.note: かんずりは唐辛子・塩・柚子・糀のみだが、明太子の漬け込み液は未記載。Kanzuri itself is chilli, salt, yuzu and koji, but the roe's own curing liquor normally carries soy and sake — ask.

items.en: Tare-katsu — Niigata City's own cutlet: pounded thin, fried, then dunked whole in sweet soy. The local soul food
items.section: 新潟こだわり料理 Niigata specialities
items.note: 衣＝パン粉、甘辛醤油ダレにくぐらせる。Breadcrumbs plus a sweet-soy dunk — wheat twice over.

items.en: Salmon shiokara — fatty salmon rested in salt koji until it turns soft and creamy
items.section: 新潟こだわり料理 Niigata specialities
items.note: 塩糀＝米麹と塩。Shio-koji is rice koji and salt, which would be clean, but the shop does not publish the full recipe — ask.

items.en: Niigata seafood rice bowl — Japan Sea fish, sweet shrimp, salmon and ikura. Comes with miso soup and pickles
items.note: いくらは醤油漬け、かけ醤油付き。The ikura is soy-cured and the bowl is dressed with soy.

items.en: Tare-katsu over rice, with miso soup and pickles
items.note: 衣＝パン粉、甘辛醤油ダレ。Breadcrumbs and sweet soy.

items.ja: じゃこと大葉の焼きおにぎり
items.romaji: jako to oba no yaki onigiri
items.en: Grilled rice ball with whitebait and shiso — one, and it smells wonderful
items.note: 焼きおにぎりは醤油を塗って焼く。A yaki-onigiri is brushed with soy before grilling. ¥230 in the 〆 list, ¥380 in the onigiri list — the size differs.

items.ja: 海苔のおむすび（塩／焼き鮭／辛味噌／梅干／明太子）
items.en: Big old-fashioned rice balls in nori — plain salt ¥350, spicy miso ¥400, umeboshi ¥430, salmon ¥480, mentaiko ¥480. The shop jokes they are the size of the ones in folk tales
items.note: 塩むすびは米・塩・海苔のみ。The plain salt one is rice, salt and nori — ask that nothing else goes on. The 辛味噌 and 明太子 fillings carry miso and cured roe; the salmon is fish.

items.en: Ochazuke — plain nori ¥450, grilled salmon / umeboshi / mentaiko ¥530
items.note: 出汁＝鰹、醤油入りが一般的。Bonito dashi, normally with soy in it.

items.en: Clam miso soup, for when you want something in a bowl
items.note: 味噌の種類が未記載。Miso type unpublished — ask, since a 麦味噌 would be barley. Clams.

items.en: Hegi soba from Tokamachi — soba bound with funori seaweed instead of wheat, laid in one-bite coils on a long wooden 'hegi' box and shared around the table. 2–3 people
items.note: つなぎは布海苔だが、打ち粉と麺つゆが小麦、市販のへぎそばも小麦粉を含むのが通例。The binder being seaweed does NOT make this gluten-free: the dusting flour on the board is wheat, the tsuyu is wheat soy, and hegi soba is normally still cut with wheat flour. 4〜5人盛り ¥3,700。

items.en: Mini sasa-dango — Niigata's mugwort rice cakes wrapped in bamboo grass, two
items.note: 笹団子は米粉と餡が基本だが、市販品は小麦粉を混ぜるものがある。Sasa-dango is normally glutinous rice flour and bean paste, but commercial versions sometimes cut it with wheat flour — ask.

items.en: Tare-katsu lunch set — the shop's own recommendation at lunchtime
items.section: 新潟グルメランチ Lunch
items.note: 衣＝パン粉、タレ＝甘辛醤油。Breadcrumbs and sweet soy.

items.ja: 新潟地魚の海鮮丼定食
items.en: Seafood bowl lunch — Japan Sea fish, sweet shrimp, salmon, ikura
items.section: 新潟グルメランチ Lunch
items.note: いくらの醤油漬けとかけ醤油。Soy-cured roe and soy dressing.

items.ja: へぎ盛り天ぷらそば定食
items.en: Hegi soba with tempura lunch — prawn, chikuwa and okra, plus as much white rice as you like
items.section: 新潟グルメランチ Lunch
items.note: そば・天ぷら・つゆの三重に小麦。Wheat three ways: the soba, the batter and the tsuyu.

items.ja: 週替りドゥ定食（おかず２点）
items.en: Weekly two-dish set — the cheap regulars' lunch, mentaiko included. One week it was pork belly in the house sauce and salt-grilled mackerel
items.section: 新潟グルメランチ Lunch
items.note: 内容が毎週変わるため一概に言えない。Contents change weekly — ask on the day. Most weeks include at least one soy-seasoned dish.

items.ja: ワンプレート定食（３点のおかず）
items.en: One-plate lunch, three dishes — one week it was sashimi, grilled beef tongue with spring onion, and a croquette
items.section: 新潟グルメランチ Lunch
items.note: 内容が毎週変わる。Contents change weekly — ask.

items.ja: 三元豚ロースのカツカレー定食
items.romaji: sangenton roosu no katsu karee teishoku
items.en: Sangen pork cutlet curry set — medium heat, round-tasting with a spice lift
items.section: 新潟グルメランチ Lunch
items.note: カレールウも衣も小麦。Wheat roux and breadcrumbs.

items.ja: 牛たんとタンシチュー定食
items.en: Beef tongue and tongue-stew set — grilled tongue, stewed tongue and grated yam, with free rice refills
items.section: 新潟グルメランチ Lunch
items.note: シチューのルウ＝小麦。The stew is thickened with a wheat roux.

items.ja: 自家製ハンバーグ定食
items.en: House hamburg steak set — the shop warns the sauce will cost you a second bowl of rice
items.section: 新潟グルメランチ Lunch
items.note: つなぎのパン粉とソース＝小麦。Breadcrumb binder and wheat sauce.

items.ja: 三元豚ロースの煮カツ定食
items.en: Simmered pork cutlet set — cutlet, tofu and onion bound with egg
items.section: 新潟グルメランチ Lunch
items.note: 衣＋割下＝小麦、卵とじ。Breadcrumbs, soy broth and egg.

items.en: Fried oyster set with tartare sauce — a winter lunch
items.section: 新潟グルメランチ Lunch
items.note: パン粉＝小麦、タルタルソース＝卵。Breadcrumbs, shared fryer, egg-based tartare.

items.ja: レジェンド３梅利き酒セット
items.en: The Three Plums tasting flight — Koshi-no-Kanbai, which set off the whole Niigata sake boom; Setchubai, sharp and full; and Mine-no-Hakubai, light. 3 × 60ml
items.section: 利き酒セット Tasting flights
items.note: 日本酒＝米と米麹。Sake is rice and rice koji; no allergen line is published, so ask if you are strict. The single best-value way into this list.

items.ja: 越乃雪月花 利き酒セット
items.en: Setsugekka flight — junmai daiginjo, junmai and honjozo from the Myoko brewery, side by side. 3 × 60ml
items.section: 利き酒セット Tasting flights
items.note: 日本酒＝米と米麹。The Joetsu style is soft and slightly sweet.

items.ja: 越乃寒梅 白ラベル（新潟市）
items.en: Koshi-no-Kanbai White Label — the bottle that started the Niigata boom. Clean, bracingly dry. 1合 flask
items.note: 日本酒＝米と米麹。Rice sake.

items.ja: 雪中梅 ふつう酒（上越市）
items.en: Setchubai regular-grade — soft, sweet-leaning, made on Kubiki's good water
items.note: ふつう酒は醸造アルコール添加（通常サトウキビ由来）。Futsushu has added distilled alcohol, normally cane-derived, but it is not labelled.

items.ja: よしかわ杜氏 大辛口（上越市）
items.en: Yoshikawa Toji, very dry — easy to drink but with real body. The shop says take it warm
items.note: 日本酒＝米と米麹。One of the cheapest flasks on the list.

items.ja: かたふね 特別本醸造（上越市）
items.en: Katafune special honjozo — the rice sweetness opens out and then vanishes
items.note: 本醸造は醸造アルコール添加。Added distilled alcohol, source unlabelled.

items.ja: 吟田川 特別純米（上越市）
items.en: Chibitagawa special junmai — distinctive, broad, full of umami
items.note: 特別純米＝米と米麹のみ。Rice and rice koji only.

items.ja: 鮎正宗 純米（妙高市）
items.en: Ayumasamune junmai from Myoko — mild, refined, gently sweet
items.note: 純米＝米と米麹のみ。

items.ja: 越乃雪月花 純米大吟醸（上越市）
items.en: Setsugekka junmai daiginjo — round, generous, nothing sharp about it
items.note: 純米大吟醸＝高精白の米と米麹。

items.ja: 八海山 魚沼で候 純米（地元限定酒・南魚沼市）
items.en: Hakkaisan 'Uonuma de Sourou' — a junmai sold only inside the Uonuma region, and rarely seen in Tokyo
items.note: 純米＝米と米麹。地元限定酒。A region-only release.

items.ja: 八海山 ふつう酒（地元限定酒・南魚沼市）
items.en: Hakkaisan regular-grade — another local-only bottle. The shop notes you almost never see the futsushu in Tokyo, and warns you will drink too much of it
items.note: ふつう酒は醸造アルコール添加。Added distilled alcohol, source unlabelled.

items.ja: 鶴齢 雪男 本醸造（南魚沼市）
items.en: Kakurei 'Yukiotoko' honjozo — built for eating with
items.note: 本醸造は醸造アルコール添加。

items.ja: 麒麟山 純米（東蒲原郡）
items.en: Kirinzan junmai — the shop's own pick: light, round, a touch of bitterness, and a clean cut
items.note: 純米＝米と米麹のみ。Flagged おすすめ by the shop.

items.ja: 麒麟山 伝辛（東蒲原郡）
items.en: Kirinzan Denkara — the dry everyday one, and the base of the shop's Kirinzan sour
items.note: 日本酒＝米と米麹。

items.ja: 白瀧 湊屋藤助 純米大吟醸（南魚沼市）
items.en: Shirataki 'Minatoya Tosuke' junmai daiginjo — from the Jozen Mizu-no-Gotoshi brewery, fruity and easy
items.note: 純米大吟醸＝米と米麹のみ。

items.en: Midorikawa junmai — an aromatic yeast; one of the most sought-after junmai in the prefecture
items.note: 純米＝米と米麹のみ。

items.ja: 鶴の友 純米（地元限定酒・新潟市）
items.en: Tsuru-no-Tomo junmai — another local-only bottle; light with a faint fruitiness
items.note: 純米＝米と米麹。地元限定酒。

items.ja: 久保田 萬寿 純米大吟醸（長岡市）
items.en: Kubota Manju — the top of the Kubota range and the most expensive flask here
items.note: 純米大吟醸＝米と米麹のみ。

items.ja: 久保田 千寿 吟醸（長岡市）
items.en: Kubota Senju ginjo — the one everyone has heard of
items.note: 吟醸は醸造アルコール添加。Added distilled alcohol, source unlabelled.

items.ja: 〆張鶴 純 純米吟醸（村上市）
items.en: Shimeharitsuru 'Jun' junmai ginjo from Murakami
items.note: 純米吟醸＝米と米麹のみ。

items.ja: 〆張鶴 花 ふつう酒（地元限定酒・村上市）
items.en: Shimeharitsuru 'Hana' — the dry local-only regular grade the shop calls the one that never lets you down
items.note: ふつう酒は醸造アルコール添加。地元限定酒。

items.ja: 菊水ふなぐち一番しぼり 本醸造生原酒（新発田市）
items.en: Kikusui Funaguchi — the unpasteurised undiluted honjozo from the famous gold can
items.note: 本醸造生原酒。Unpasteurised and undiluted; added distilled alcohol, source unlabelled.

items.ja: 越乃景虎 名水仕込み 特別純米（長岡市）
items.en: Koshi-no-Kagetora special junmai, brewed on the spring water of Todoro-no-Mori — one of Japan's hundred famous waters
items.note: 特別純米＝米と米麹のみ。

items.ja: 吉乃川 厳選辛口（長岡市）
items.en: Yoshinogawa dry — smooth, umami-forward, clean finish. Cheap and reliable
items.note: 日本酒＝米と米麹。

items.ja: 天神囃子 ふつう酒（十日町市）
items.en: Tenjinbayashi regular-grade from Tokamachi — polished to ginjo levels at 60% despite the grade
items.note: ふつう酒は醸造アルコール添加。

items.ja: 田友 特別純米（小千谷市）
items.en: Denyu special junmai — dry-leaning but built around the rice's own flavour
items.note: 特別純米＝米と米麹のみ。

items.ja: 北雪「鬼ころし」超辛口（佐渡）
items.en: Hokusetsu 'Onikoroshi' — Sado island's version of the ultra-dry demon-killer
items.note: 日本酒＝米と米麹。

items.ja: 越乃寒梅 米焼酎 5年熟成古酒
items.en: Koshi-no-Kanbai rice shochu, 5 years old, 40% — refermented from daiginjo lees, so it smells of the sake it came from. By the glass
items.section: 新潟米焼酎 Niigata rice shochu
items.note: 大吟醸の酒粕を再発酵させた米焼酎。Rice shochu from rice-sake lees — no barley in the chain, but nothing is formally labelled, so ask.

items.en: Hakkaisan rice shochu — vacuum-distilled from moromi and aged two years; faintly ginjo-scented. By the glass
items.section: 新潟米焼酎 Niigata rice shochu
items.note: 米焼酎＝米と米麹。Rice shochu — no barley involved, but unlabelled.

items.ja: クラフトビール 新潟阿賀野スワンレイク こしひかり仕込み
